scene.title: 序
scene.dialog: 「Phew...」

motion.img: 枕玉-闭眼张嘴-敲门-中景（汗）

text.p: The boy took a deep breath.
He reached out to knock on the door, but stopped just before his fist hit it.

scene.dialog: 「Why me...?」
scene.text: Discontent and helplessness swirled in the boy’s heart.

The boy’s name was Zhenyu. He had been her disciple for less than three months since he first joined the Edge of Taixuanpai faction, but she sent him to his room on top of Heavensky Peak so that they could get a good scolding from their family head

motion.img: 枕玉-闭眼张嘴-敲门-中景（汗）

scene.dialog: （Pushing the role of being scolded by a family head onto me? Both my older sister and apprentice are terrible...）
scene.text: The boy imagined the headman’s angry appearance, feeling uneasy and restless.

mono.p: The head of the Taixuan Faction—『Willowfoil』, also known as Lin Zhaoyu.
She’d turned fifty-six this year, and she was past the age of knowing Celestial
The elite Celestial ascended to the heavens engulfing in golden light, and Mount Taixuan was consumed by flame.
After that, she and her six brother apprentices—who had been the first disciples of a Celestial — remained here at Tensomine
He rebuilt the Taixuan school.
After a little over ten years, the Taixuan Faction came back to life splendidly
He was one of the six great schools in Shinshu martial arts.
Because of that, Lin Zhaoyu's fame was also very high and her husband 『Tsukkomaken』.
Together with Ma Feima, they had become a married couple of martial artists that everyone in the world envied
As the master of his family, Lin Zhaoyu was by no means an eccentric person.
Quite the opposite, she was kind and gentle to everyone
We treat each other equally.
Except for a few exceptions.[\s]
Whenever I interacted with those exceptions, Lin Zhaoyu was always there
She went mad with rage, as if someone had changed.

scene.text: When the boy first came to Tianqiu Peak, his caring older brothers told him all about it.

dialog.p: 「You just got here, Zhenyu. I'll teach you the rules of this place!
In front of the family head, I absolutely mustn't mention a certain topic and their names.」
「By a certain topic, she meant the vice-head.
No matter what you ask, don't tell the head of a family about your vice-head being out there. There is no need for me to interfere with these two」

scene.dialog: 「That'll be fine.」

text.p: Zhenyu nodded hastily. An outsider shouldn't be interfering with the problem of a married couple
He is not the talkative type. Therefore, he will never make such a mistake

scene.dialog: 「I found out about a certain topic. And what's their names?」
「One of them is our master’s teacher—in other words, Master Phoenix...」
scene.text: The siblings suddenly lowered their voices and looked around.
scene.dialog: 「You may not have heard this name before, since you're all so young. But once upon a time the Great Teacher was very famous—a god who hasn’t aged even for one thousand years after he went down to Gekai」

「Phoenix returned to the Celestial world twenty years ago. But don't provoke him by saying that out loud, okay? He never took you away when Master Daishi ascended into heaven... so I have been worried about it for some time now!」
「Yeah, yeah.」
scene.text: Phoenix’s name faded over time, but the boy had heard a lot of stories about her. In fact it was precisely because 『The only true Celestial』 existed that he traveled all this way to Tensomine and became an apprentice in Taixuan Faction
scene.dialog: 「The other name is 『Musou』, also known as Su Mei. She's a younger sister apprentice of the family head but their relationship has water and oil...」
「Don't say this name out loud, or even hear it in your ears. If you run into anyone from the Musoumon Gate and find them hiding somewhere far away... You can never have anything to do with 'em!」
「Huh?」

mono.p: Musoumon—it was almost twenty years ago, with the new Taixuan Faction
It was founded around the same time, but on a completely different scale.
Right now, the Taixuan Faction is one of those six great factions
Musoumon is still a small sect.
However, no one dared lay a hand on the disciples of Musoumon.
The reason for that was the head of family, 『Saishoku Kanebi』’s Su Mei.
A woman with peerless beauty and superior intelligence.
Su Mei was Phoenix’s second disciple, but in the martial arts world
He was considered to be the most fearsome of The Seven Great Void Swords, and he revered him with awe
It was called 『Onna Zhuge』 or『Musousennin』.

scene.dialog: 「...Is it really that scary?」
scene.text: The brothers looked at each other and nodded in unison.
scene.dialog: 「It's terrifying.」

motion.img: 枕玉-闭眼张嘴-敲门-中景（汗）

scene.text: As he stood there in a daze, the headman’s voice came from inside his room.
scene.dialog: 「What are you spacing out for outside, Zhenyu?」

motion.img: 枕玉-吃惊张嘴-标准-中景

scene.dialog: 「Ah... Yes! My apprentice, Zhenyu. I'm coming in」
scene.text: The boy was nervous, but at the same time excited.

motion.img: 枕玉-吃惊张嘴-标准-中景（多汗）

scene.dialog: 「Master... How do you know me?」
「Why? I'm not old enough to even remember the names of my disciples.」

text.p: The head of the family answered.
There was a hint of self-derision in her voice rather than condemnation.

scene.dialog: 「217 members of the gate faction remember everyone.[\s]His internal breathing is ragged, and his steps are unsteady. He clearly hasn't built up the basics yet—the only one who can do that would be someone like you just introduced to this school」
「...Ah, y-yes. I'll keep training from now on!」
scene.text: Zhenyu instantly broke out in a cold sweat.[\s]It had only been three months since he became a pupil, and 『Tai Yijing』 was still learning how to become an introductory student at『Edge of Taixuan』. That's why just climbing the Irimo Floor made him out of breath
My master’s words were indifferent, but Zhenyu sounded like she had pointed out my lack of training and I suddenly felt embarrassed.
scene.dialog: 「Climbing up to the top of this cloud floor is pretty impressive. Don't scare her like that, okay?」
scene.text: Zhenyu felt a little strange. That voice didn't sound like it belonged to the head of our family just now
The door suddenly opened. Inside stood a woman more beautiful than the boy had ever seen before, smiling faintly
The head of the family behind her, Lin Zhaoyu—had a dark look on his face.
scene.dialog: 「Su Mei... Since you're a Musoumon, how long has it been since I started appraising my disciples?」
「Oh, did I say something unnecessary?」
scene.text: The stunningly beautiful woman turned toward Zhenyu and blinked.
At that point, Lin Zhaoyu finally turned to look at the boy.
scene.dialog: 「What do you want, Zhenyu? Tell me.」

motion.img: 枕玉-吃惊张嘴-标准-中景（汗）

scene.text: The boy couldn't help but hesitate. He had come to apologize for his master in place of a disciple and older sister

mono.p: It's early morning. 『Musousennin』, also known as Su Mei suddenly came to Tensomine...
He’d said he needed to tell the headman what his vice-head had told him.
The older disciples and elder brothers were afraid of incurring their master’s wrath
No one tried to climb the mountain with Su Mei.
While we were doing that, the head of Musoumon Gate was gone...
...No one would have thought he was already in the cloud of dust.

scene.text: Not knowing what to do, the boy decided he should just tell her as it was.

motion.img: 枕玉-闭眼张嘴-标准-中景（汗）

scene.dialog: 「Yes, Master. The head of the Musou Gate Resurrection would like to meet with you again! My second disciple Nee-san and Brother Xuanli can't decide on their own so I was told that they should go up a mountain for my report...」
「Hehe.」
scene.text: Su Mei, who was off to the side of it all, laughed out loud without thinking.
The head of the family made a clearly unamused face as he spoke coldly.
scene.dialog: 「Why would you report something like that when she's right here? Go back.」
「Yes... Excuse me.」
scene.text: Zhenyu hung its head and bowed.
scene.dialog: 「And then...」
scene.text: The head of the family sighed and spoke in a gentle voice
scene.dialog: 「You don't have to come here on errands anymore. Genri will teach you the secrets of Taixuan, and make sure that your foundation is solid enough for both tai-chiehyun (Taixuanitsuyuu Tingling), as well! That way climbing up a mountain should not be too tiring after all...」
「Understood.」
scene.text: The head of the family was thinking about him—Zhenyu moved from his heart, but he didn’t know what to say. He just bowed and said:
scene.dialog: 「Thank you very much.」
「Go.」

scene.title: 序2
scene.text: The boy bowed, then turned his back and headed down the mountain. Lin Zhaoyu watched her pupil disappear toward a stone staircase before turning to face Su Mei in silence
scene.dialog: 「I think of you as a younger sister apprentice, but there's no right to interfere with my Taixuan school.」
「I'm sorry.」
scene.text: Still smiling, Su Mei turned her gaze far away and then looked around this small room again.
scene.dialog: 「The Taixuan Faction, the Kumokan... Heheh. They're all yours now!」
scene.text: Lin Zhaoyu responded coldly with a snort of “Hmph.”
scene.dialog: 「Either way, the Taixuan family must be informed. I can't allow them to break off with my own hands!」
「*sigh* Of the seven of us, Miss Zhaoyu seems to miss her most.」
scene.text: The two of them continued their small talk, never getting down to business. Lin Zhaoyu patiently waited for him but Su Mei seemed interested in the little things
scene.dialog: 「Miss Zhaoyu's pupil has quite a bit of potential, and she does have some nerve. It is just too bad that he was male; it will be difficult to train Little Ma into her own level」

「...When I take apprentices, my talent is not as important to me. And Yanqing has enough martial arts skills that no one can compete with him in the first place! Men and women don't matter—not even a single disciple of mine could match his」
「But Zhenyus certainly do have a knack for it. The Void Faction will be passed on to future generations eventually, and he might become my last disciple!」
「Miss Zhaoyu, are you thinking about your last apprentice now?」

motion.img: 林朝雨-心头一震-标准-中景

scene.text: Lin Zhaoyu was somewhat dumbfounded, and suddenly went pale.

She was the oldest of Phoenix’s seven disciples, and fifteen years older than her second[\s]Lin Zhaoyu hadn’t bothered him at first, but now that years have passed and he is married to the youngest Ma Feima has made his age even more apparent
scene.dialog: 「Su Mei, stop trying to test my patience... Let's get back on topic.」
scene.text: The head of the Taixuan Faction would break through their groping each other's stomach.
scene.dialog: 「Master resurrected, sister apprentice dead. Now it's our turn—what are you going to do?[\s]You didn't come to see me for the first time in a long while just so we could chat, right? Are you... planning on killing my master again.」
scene.text: Lin Zhaoyu took her younger sister apprentice’s silence as an affirmation.
scene.dialog: 「I don't like you, Su Mei. But in the past she thought of me as her own little sister... So let’s give some advice to that effect:」
「It's different now. The seven of us will never be together again, and we were just lucky back then... There is no guarantee that it would turn out the same even if I tried one more time」
scene.text: Lin Zhaoyu let out a long sigh.

motion.img: 林朝雨-心头一震-标准-中景

dialog.p: 「It's been twenty years, but I never forgot that night...
Wanxi and Lingshuang nearly lost their lives. If it weren't for you, that sword with the face of Yanqingru would have been a disaster...」

scene.dialog: 「You really do miss the past, don't you? Heheh. It has been twenty years already! 『If...』 is nothing like that...」

text.p: Su Mei had absolutely no interest in the past.
Lin Zhaoyu understood, but she couldn't agree with him at all.

scene.dialog: 「Hmph, tell me. What's your plan?」
「I don't have a plan.」
scene.text: In the martial arts world, everyone acknowledged that she was intelligent and earned her nickname of 『Chikei Musou』—Su Mei. That’s what he said
scene.dialog: 「No matter how hard you think about it, there's no plan that will work out perfectly. If everything goes according to your plans then Master should be dead by now and he won’t come back into this world...」
「That's why I have no intention of making any plans. Change happens all the time, and it is impossible to calculate a human heart...」
scene.text: Something cold suddenly welled up in the hearts of Lin Zhaoyu.
He hated Su Mei, but on the inside he believed she must have had some kind of plan.

Just like twenty years ago, when she gathered seven people and plotted to kill Phoenix—the invincible True Celestial. —The world would change with time; I knew that but the Taixuana Seven Swords had also changed from before
scene.dialog: 「So, you...」
「Yeah, I don't have a plan. But there are plenty of ways to do it!」
scene.text: Lin Zhaoyu frowned suspiciously.
scene.dialog: 「A way?」
「Yes.」

dialog.p: 「Twenty years ago, we buried our master and set fire to Mount Taixuan.
After that, I went back to the mountains and found something suspicious.」

scene.dialog: 「Master's sword was missing.」
scene.text: Su Mei takes a step forward. There seems to be an even deeper meaning behind her gaze as she stares at the Lin Zhaoyu
scene.dialog: 「...It was gone?」
scene.text: Su Mei was staring at Lin Zhaoyu’s face, but she suddenly averted her gaze.
scene.dialog: 「...It's not my sister.」
「Huh?」
scene.text: Su Mei smiled faintly on her face, as if she had come up with something interesting.
scene.dialog: 「By the time I returned, Master's coffin had been burned to a crisp. The bones inside it were scorched and there was no sign of them at all! Unfortunately for you—I decided on where they should be —because in that place we thought fire would never pass us by」
「That's why I investigated the crime scene. Then, as expected...」
「The body inside the coffin didn't belong to my master.」
「...What did you say?」

dialog.p: 「In other words... You've known Master was alive for a long time? Did you know that twenty years ago, dearest Mell.
And yet, she didn't tell me... She said nothing and kept quiet.」
「I didn't know. Never knew... What about Lord Yanqing? Do you not understand the situation either, Wanxi and Wanru ...
Besides, Suyi. At the very least I have to let her know―」

scene.dialog: 「No, I didn't tell anyone.」
scene.text: Lin Zhaoyu steps back. Suddenly, a sharp pain runs through her cheeks as the old man crushes his pride of being an imaginary sword-fighting leader and makes it seem like she'll be ten years older in no time at all—time is eradicating any deception that might come to mind for him

dialog.p: 「I've lived in solitude for the rest of my life. She is not like us, and we are making preparations... But either way—I cannot afford to let her know about this
Why did you not tell us, Su Mei?」

scene.dialog: 「That's right... I wonder why?」
scene.text: Su Mei mutters. There seems to be a fog in her eyes

The words come out of his mouth in a daze. Su Mei looks around as if she's upset, like an old man who has lost all memory and is searching for some treasure he doesn’t even know himself about from within the piled-up relic
scene.dialog: 「It's just... I need a little more time.」
scene.text: She closes her eyes as she says that. It seems like this is the end of a topic for us to talk about, huh?[\s]When she opened her mouth again, the illusion of an old man had vanished. Standing before Lin Zhaoyu was none other than a calm master at Musoumon Gate
scene.dialog: 「That's right... I knew it for a long time. Twenty years ago, my master disappeared from Mount Taixuan—someone might have stolen his body and he may already be resurrected — so there was no way you could tell? It just occurred to me that one 『Possible.』 existed」
「Master isn't dead, he might be alive.」

dialog.p: 「No matter how unbelievable it may be, as long as there's a possibility I can’t ignore them.[\s]
That's why I created the Muso Gate and sent them all across Zhongyuan. They not only defeated evil spirits, but also gave me missions to locate my master in search of suspicious locations」
「And I...
For the past few years, Master and I have been trying to find out more about this sword. We've learned a lot from it![\s]
I don't have any proof that we can win, but there are plenty of ways to use it.」

scene.text: 『Means』... Those words made Lin Zhaoyu feel a little uncomfortable.

motion.img: 林朝雨-心头一震-标准-近景

scene.dialog: 「You mustn't do anything dirty to your master. He is Phoenix, after all!」
「Yes... I have no intention of being rude to my master.」
scene.text: A faint smile appeared on Su Mei’s lips, but there was sadness mixed in.
scene.dialog: 「If my master is coming to kill me, then that’s only natural. Those who are killed have the right of vengeance」
「But I don't regret killing my master. If not for that, we would still be in endless agony right now... What about you?」
scene.text: The thirty years they’d spent together had become a thin needle, lightly stabbing into the chest of this headwoman who belonged to the Taixuan faction
scene.dialog: 「...I don't regret it either.」
scene.text: Lin Zhaoyu spoke in a quiet voice.

dialog.p: 「It's fine. I have no intention of sitting down and waiting for death, so from now on we will fight my master with all our might! Only God knows if he is alive or dead—[\s]
That's why I came here. Miss Zhaoyu, please lend me your strength!」

text.p: Lin Zhaoyu stared at the red-haired woman in front of her.[\s]
In the past, she had been her own little sister and best friend. She was a comrade in love with him; he thought that once they parted ways there would be nothing to do between them until their deaths

scene.text: But right now, various emotions swirled in the hearts of Lin Zhaoyu.
And then, at the end of her sentence...

motion.img: 林朝雨-心头一震-标准-近景

scene.dialog: 「Go ahead and say it.」
scene.text: Su Mei stepped out of the cloud view and spread her arms wide at a peak in Tianqiu Peak, drawing circles as she answered.
scene.dialog: 「I want to have Zhaoyu Nee-san's sword style.」

scene.title: 西の世界
scene.text: In the middle of the desert, Li Sushang suddenly woke up.

motion.img: 素裳-疲惫无神-持剑-中景

text.p: Her heart was beating frantically, and her clothes were soaked in cold sweat.
The girl subconsciously touched the cloth bag beside her and held the Xuanyuan Sword, and her heart was put at ease.

scene.dialog: [Did you have a nightmare?]
scene.text: A familiar voice came from the side.
She turned to look at the speaking Raksha.
How strange. When they first met, he wasn’t fluent in Shenzhounese, and he still had an awkward western accent. But within less than two days, he was speaking on par with the locals.
scene.dialog: [... I, I’m fine.]
scene.text: Raksha shrugged, looked away, toasted, and drank the trembling red liquid. When he put down the wine glass, the red liquid immediately stopped shaking. It always maintained the same amount, never increasing nor decreasing.
The girl was often curious what the liquid was, she had a few ideas, but didn’t dare to ask.
Li Sushang got up, her sleepiness was gone. She shook her clothes, sat down beside Raksha, and began to observe the mysterious demonic flame in front of her.
This thing looked evil.
It looked like a blue ball on the surface, no matter how it rolled, the flames within remained stationary, continuing to illuminate light and emit heat.
The desert’s temperature during the night was extremely cold, but the two people and horses that surrounded the ball didn't feel cold at all.
scene.dialog: (This guy’s tricks are pretty amazing…)
scene.text: Sushang couldn’t help but look at the blond man next to her.
scene.dialog: [Hey, Raksha.]
[I have a name.]
[You guys have such strange names, it’s too bothersome for me to remember.]

text.img: 奥托-微笑释然-标准-中景

scene.text: Raksha smiled slightly, ignored her, and cast his gaze to the coffin next to him.

motion.img: 奥托-微笑释然-标准-中景

text.p: He had always been carrying this huge and heavy coffin, murmuring to it, and making Sushang extremely uncomfortable.

scene.text: Li Sushang waited for a bit, but Raksha continued to remain silent.
scene.dialog: [Hey… why are you looking for the Celestial?]

text.img: 奥托-微笑自信-标准-中景
text.p: There was a long long silence.
When Sushang was searching for the next topic, Raksha suddenly spoke.

motion.img: 奥托-微笑自信-标准-中景

dialog.img: 素裳-悲伤目前-持剑-中景

scene.dialog: [I’ve seen the Celestial once before.]

motion.img: 素裳-悲伤目前-持剑-中景

scene.dialog: [Eh?]
scene.text: The girl was confused at first, then she rolled her eyes:

dialog.p: [Ah, you lied to me again. You asked me who the Celestial was before.
Tsk tsk, you Raksha people don’t like telling the truth.]

scene.dialog: [I’m not lying, but, this is a story from a long time ago.]
[No problem. I’ve got time, and I don’t feel like sleeping anytime soon.]
scene.text: The Raksha looked at the sand under his feet.
scene.dialog: [You really want to hear it?]
[Yep! But don’t make it too complicated, keep it simple, just a bit.]
[Alright. Twenty years ago…]
[Wait a minute, twenty years ago? How old are you now?]

dialog.img: 素裳-悲伤目前-持剑-中景

scene.dialog: [...If you keep interrupting me, I won’t be able to continue.]

motion.img: 素裳-悲伤目前-持剑-中景

scene.dialog: [Ah, I’m sorry, continue.]
scene.text: Raksha let out a long sigh.
scene.dialog: [Twenty years ago, there was a war between Europe and Shenzhou. The expedition force sent by Europe was called the Knights of Schicksal, I was included.
The Ming Empire was very powerful, Schicksal had never encountered such a strong opponent. But with Walküre and Der Schlüssel Gottes, Schicksal still prevailed—]
[Hey hey hey— Wait again, what baby, and what ears?]
scene.text: Li Sushang pouted in dissatisfaction.
scene.dialog: [I said that you guys have really weird names, yet you keep saying so much! You really like bullying me!?]
[...I’m really sorry, I’m just so used to it.]
scene.text: The Raksha put out his hands and shrugged.

dialog.img: 素裳-大笑潇洒-背手-中景

scene.dialog: [I’ll use your Shenzhou language to explain it.]

motion.img: 素裳-大笑潇洒-背手-中景

scene.dialog: [Oh oh, that’s perfect~ go ahead, I won’t interrupt this time.]
[Err…]
[Eh?]
scene.text: It appeared that it was too difficult to switch between two contexts, as the Raksha opened and closed his mouth several times, yet he couldn’t speak.
scene.dialog: [Anyways… yes. The Knights of the West, they’re just like Shenzhou’s Wuxia.]
scene.text: The Raksha finally found his way, clapped his hands, showed a helpless expression, and couldn’t help but smile:

scene.title: 天命派

motion.img: 奥托-微笑自信-摊手-中景

dialog.p: [Allow me to start from the beginning: to the west of Shenzhou, there’s another continent called Europe.[\s]
You have different sects and houses in Shenzhou, while there’s only one in Europe, called Schicksal.]

motion.img: 奥托-微笑自信-单空手-中景

scene.dialog: [The Schicksal Sect was established by three families, it’s said that the patriarchs’ techniques are unmatched in this world.

Schicksal quickly became a force not to be underestimated in a few years, which later, they merged with the Hall of the Divine, the Palace of Heroes, and the School of the Briar Crown, increasing its power on the continent.]

[Schicksal is an overview of the European continent, hence affairs are complex and it would be too much to handle for one person. Thus Schicksal’s power is controlled by three families… three sects, and has been for a thousand years.]
[Wow, a thousand years!]
scene.text: Li Sushang was very surprised.
scene.dialog: [Tsk tsk, that’s truly amazing, few of our Six Great Sects have a thousand years’ worth of history! Is this Schicksal a sword sect, what kind of martial arts do they practice?]

motion.img: 奥托-笑容释然-标准-中景

scene.dialog: [There’s swordsmanship, also spearmanship; but the most unique techniques passed down by Schicksal, is what you call [Magic] and [Sorcery].]

motion.img: 奥托-微笑自信-单空手-中景

scene.text: The Raksha raised his left hand, inside was a golden cross.

motion.img: 奥托-微笑奸-单十字-中景

scene.dialog: [Based on your culture, it would be more appropriate to refer to it as a Magical Relic.]

cg.img: 氛围_通用_犹大誓约启动

text.p: The golden chains flashed. Li Sushang suddenly felt her body lose power as her internal strength dissipated.
After a short moment, everything went back to normal.

scene.text: She looked at the Raksha’s palm, the golden cross already dissipated, and became smoke.

motion.img: 素裳-疲惫无神-持剑-中景
奥托-微笑释然-标准-中景

scene.dialog: (Eh, this feels…)

dialog.p: [This is one of the three Magical Relics of Schicksal: [Oath of Judah];
it can seal away Honkai Energy— [Ki] Circulation.]
[And what I used to heal you last night, was another Magical Relic called [Abyss Flower];
it can heal the human body, regenerate bones and activate muscles. As long as there’s enough Ki, now matter how severe the injury is, it can be healed.]

scene.dialog: [But, two of the Magical Relics you’ve seen aren’t real, they’re both mimicries.]
scene.text: The Raksha then gently tapped his temple with his slender fingers.
scene.dialog: [In here, even Schicksal Sect doesn’t know its existence, it’s my unique Magical Relic— [Void Archives].]

[Everything I’ve seen, touched, and understood, Void Archives can [mimic] using Ki, and manifest into an entity. [\s]Because of this, I can replicate the power of the three Magical Relics of Schicksal.]

motion.img: 奥托-微笑自信-标准-中景

text.p: Li Sushang crossed her arms and tilted her head, then she bit her lips. [\s]
It wasn’t that she didn’t believe the Raksha’s words, but her brain had been turned to mush by a bunch of information.

scene.dialog: [...Hold on, hold on. That Schicksal Sect sounds fun, Magical Relics and what…]
scene.text: Sushang pouted in annoyance:
scene.dialog: [How did we suddenly talk about cultivation and relics? I know you’re very good and don’t explain in such details. So let’s talk about the Schicksal Sect then.]
[Mm.]
scene.text: The Raksha sighed, then looked at Sushang:

motion.img: 奥托-微笑自信-单空手-中景

scene.dialog: [Schicksal has a firm control over Europe, after a long time, its ambition swelled and finally focused on its vast neighbors. Twenty years ago, Schicksal sent troops to attack— err, visit Shenzhou, hoping to compete with Shenzhou— err, competition.]
[Your Shenzhou army was strong,
but Schicksal’s Valkyries— err, Wuxia were able to win the matches, using the help of their Magical Relics.]
scene.text: The Raksha stopped talking, rephrasing historical facts into a version that Li Sushang could understand was apparently tormenting him greatly.
The proof is— even in the scorching sun the Raksha has never sweated, yet at this moment there are already a few large beads of sweat slowly running down his delicate cheeks.
Sushang looked at his embarrassment on the side, very overjoyed.

motion.img: 奥托-微笑释然-标准-中景

scene.dialog: [Schicksal had victory close within its control, but then, the Celestial appeared.]
[That’s when I saw her…]

dialog.p: [What should I say of the Celestial…
With the wave of a hand, the heavens roared with thunder, the earth froze to ice, and flames ignited without wind.

scene.dialog: All sorts of strange sights crushed Schicksal’s formations. The Holy Knights stepped forward, but they couldn’t do anything.]
scene.text: The Raksha smiled bitterly, and his voice gradually floated farther away.

dialog.p: [Even the strongest Valkyrie… the genius who fully mastered the [Oath of Judah],
when in front of her, she was defeated…]

scene.text: The Raksha’s eyes involuntarily floated towards the coffin.

motion.img: 素裳-悲伤目前-抱手-中景

scene.text: Li Sushang paid attention to his gaze.[\s]After being with him for around a day, she noticed that although this Raksha man talked and laughed from time to time, but when he looked at that coffin, he would go into his world of solitude and loneliness.
scene.dialog: [What’s inside there?]
scene.text: Li Sushang had no interest in fighting but couldn’t help and ask.
scene.dialog: [You’re always speaking to it, is someone inside?]
[No…]
scene.text: The Raksha shook his head, he seemed confused. His eyes moved up to down the coffin, before looking at his palms again.
scene.dialog: [You don’t know? You’ve never opened it?]
scene.text: The Raksha didn’t answer her, his mind seemed to already fly to a place far away, leaving behind an empty husk besides Li Sushang
scene.dialog: [em italic]Sushang waited patiently. She held her chin, watched the Raksha staring into space with an empty gaze, wondering what he was thinking about.[/em]

text.p: (Is he missing his home?)[\s]
Missing something thousands of miles away, how could she imagine what the old country in the Western Regions was like?

dialog.p: [em italic]Perhaps he’s thinking of someone?
(... …Does he have a mom and a dad?
Aye, a stupid question, of course he does~[/em]
[em italic]He couldn’t have popped out of a rock.)
(What about friends? A lover?
He probably does… Could he be married?[/em]

scene.text: Does he have a master? Is he a disciple of the Schicksal Sect?)
The little girl realized she knew nothing about this Raksha.

Although they traveled together for two days, the girl didn’t say any meaningful words to the Raksha, though she asked his name, but she gave up the memory once she heard strange sounds. No matter how hard she tried, she couldn’t remember anything.
scene.dialog: [em italic]（I need to talk with Raksha more...）[/em]
scene.text: Sushang became a little sad.

text.p: She suddenly remembered: once she takes this Raksha to see her master, they would have to separate.[\s]
There’s only half a day left to get along with him, not saying it was long; it was short, really short.

scene.dialog: [Aye… Can Master keep him around for a few more days?]
scene.text: For some reason, the girl felt even more disappointed.
She had friends for the first time in fifteen years, enjoying the joy of getting along with them, and experienced the pain of parting.
The night was long, the two people who couldn’t sleep sat side by side, and the gods didn’t guard their homes until daylight was bright.

scene.title: 馬非馬
scene.text: A similarly sleepless man and a horse raced across the vast desert sea.

mono.p: The horse was sweating the color of blood, its hooves were gold. Its slender head and long neck had a reddish-brown body with distinctive red mane that made it look like an elongated back[\s]
They could run more than a thousand miles per day, and even with their hooves treading on the sand there were no footprints—they remained flat
The man looked like someone who had undergone training. He was large, with long hair and a short beard; his muscles were taut[\s]
There was a large scar on his face from the sword, ruining its well-groomed appearance—but it didn’t damage how heroic he looked.
This man and his horse were in perfect sync. They looked like longtime best friends who had surpassed their master-servant relationship

When people in the martial arts world see this eccentric pairing from afar, they hurl insults at each other inside their hearts. But on paper it takes Gongte's thanks and calls out to 「Vice-Head of the Horse!」 or「Mr. Horse!」 while smiling
That was because he had been the only male disciple among Phoenix’s disciples
The sixth disciple of the Seven Swords,
He was the vice-head of Tensoramine Taixuan School, which had made a name for itself widely[\s]
『Tsukkomaken』—because he's Ma Feima.
On the surface, he had a number of titles—his name was well-known and everyone in martial arts wanted to get acquainted with him

But behind the scenes, people referred to this Ma Feima as something like 『Henjin』 『Abnormal.』 『A horse that won't die even if you kill it.』 or『Madman』 and/or percentageB—and when they actually met him everyone had a friendly nod despite their headaches
As a matter of fact, there was no one who wanted to get close with him.
After all, not only were Ma Feima superior in martial arts but what they did was extremely arrogant
Despite his title as vice-head of the Taixuan faction, Ma Feima was an outstanding lone wolf
Even if he was a disciple of the Taixuan school, there weren't many opportunities to meet him every year. He spent more days with his beloved horse 『Erebus』 than Lin Zhaoyu—his wife
Ma Feima when he’s at Heavensky Peak is calm, polite and humble.
However, he became like a different person the moment they descended that mountain and accepted any fight or provocation.
It didn’t matter if the opponent was from a distinguished family or royalty and nobility at all.
Fight for justice? Exterminate evil.
There was no need for such a just cause in the Sword of Parting.
They fought when they wanted to fight, and would do so if it meant fighting.
If you want to use a sword, then do it with your own fist.
He would save the people he wanted to help, and kill those who needed him.
Everything is as my heart desires.

That's why people in the martial arts world are afraid of him and avoid it. As a result, Lin Zhaoyu is often forced to work tirelessly for his cause as well — even though he has caused quite an uproar during that time...

His enemies were all over the place, and while no one would openly try to curry favor with his Taixuan Shichiken’s wrath—there was not a small number of people who had bounties on him behind closed doors
Ma Feima attitude toward them was 「He didn't refuse to come.」.
「If you want to kill me, come. I'll be your opponent at any time!
If I run away even a little bit, it'll be cowardice for me. And if you can’t kill my life... You are useless? That is all there was to that story」
There really is no end to those who come and kill him.
Ambushes, conspiracies and traps... Poisoning. Sex appeal! Duels? matches ...
He had used every technique he could, but even so the Ma Feima was not dead. Countless terrifying scars remained on his body—but it still kept him alive and well

scene.dialog: 「My husband loves freedom, so he is impulsive and rude. But I'm not a bad person; would you please pardon him out of respect for me?[\s]If there's anything I can do to help, it is my duty as a member of the Taixuan Faction.」
scene.text: A few years ago, Lin Zhaoyu held a banquet under the pretense of celebrating her fiftieth birthday by inviting each school in martial arts[\s]The toast at the banquet was actually an apology. In place of her husband, she had begged for forgiveness from each and every force he’d offended
Ma Feima stood up with a laugh, and as punishment he himself drank several drinks to apologize many times

mono.p: The alcohol enters my stomach, turning into a man's tears.
Tears don't flow easily, and on lonely nights they turn into heavy rain.
What people thought to be true was the biggest lie in this world.
Horsemen didn’t have freedom, nor did they like it.

text.p: Knowing that his master had come back to life, Ma Feima hurried through the night toward Musoumon Gate
In order to let Su Mei know about this first.

scene.dialog: 「I know.」

「It's because my apprentice is there that information comes in. But it was only half a day earlier than you, so I came at just the right time to ask for your opinion—I had nothing but simple info on hand」
scene.text: 『Musousennin』, also known as “Su Mei” didn’t change her expression at all. When she was done listening to him he explained it once more and asked a lot about the details

dialog.p: 「It was so sudden that I only heard a few things from nearby.
After putting together all sorts of explanations, there was no doubt that she would be my master.」

scene.dialog: 「Was it still twenty years ago, or before that?」
「That's right.」
「Master doesn't grow old, does he?」
scene.text: When his second disciple laughed, Ma Feima’s heart nearly danced along with it.

dialog.p: 「...That's weird. The time and place are strange, too...
But that proves my guess was correct...」

scene.text: With that, Su Mei fell silent and turned her gaze upward out of habit.

dialog.p: 「There's something strange about your tone, Little Ma.
...Something doesn't make sense, does it?」
「Killing people, burning down buildings.
...Judging by her master’s personality, it was hard to imagine she would do something like that.」

scene.dialog: 「Yes.」
scene.text: Su Mei said with a light sigh

dialog.p: 「That's right. I think it is strange, too... At first we thought that the information was wrong or there might be some kind of ulterior motive behind all this ...
But like you said, 『Master.』 definitely showed up.」

scene.dialog: 「『Killing people and burning down buildings... Judging by my master’s personality, I doubt he would do that』, right?」
「Then what kind of personality is he? When I was a child, my master took Miss Zhaoyu with him and burned Mochiyama to the ground. He killed many people from Holy Fire Cult—I still remember it now」

dialog.p: 「Enzera manipulated the believers with sorcery, causing them to lose control. Mochiyama...
According to Lin Zhaoyu stories, it was full of serious energy there. If we left them alone they'd create monsters that would cause trouble for us all...」
「Yes, my master had killed only those who lost their minds and burned the terrible land of unearthly aura.
But does that mean it’s okay to kill or burn them?」
「...I can't say for sure about the good or bad.
But it was his duty as a disciple of the Taixuan faction to defeat demons.」

scene.text: Su Mei turned her gaze to Ma Feima’s face.
scene.dialog: 「Stampede, bewitchment and necromancy... There are many ways to call it that. It's essentially the same thing: True energy surpasses what a human body can tolerate」

「Excessive earnestness robs people of their reason, makes them mad and turns into a wild beast that can only slaughter or destroy. Once this begins there'll be no way to return it back in its original state」

「That's why I kill to save them. Taking the lives of one evil spirit is like protecting thousands and innocent people, right? Yes... The Taixuan Faction has a duty: mercilessly killing those who have fallen into demon form!」

「...I have followed those teachings and never once disobeyed them. The number of monsters my peerless gate has defeated in the past twenty years must be less than a thousand, but I've yet to feel proud about it—not only that...but even more so because they despise this commandment」

「...Should they really have died?[\s]Most of the people who went berserk were ordinary folks with no experience in martial arts, and only a few had children from warrior families. They're mostly commoners—not bad guys at all!」
「It's just... unfortunately, 『Maki』 brought about a disaster.」

dialog.p: 「『Maki』 has no eyes, and『Ten'i』 doesn't have mercy. That is why humans become dogs
You said that it's not wrong for a master to kill someone. I think so too, but mistakes are always there...」

scene.dialog: 「If there are no mistakes in my master, me or the dead—then that means it's up to heaven.」

「Little Ma, the Void is nothing more than a cage. No matter how amazing my master's martial arts skills may seem to me—she’ll always be 『Sora』 prisoner! Now that twenty years have passed since she died... do you think this『Extermination of demons』 precept can still bind her?」
「Don't judge new things based on your impressions of the past. You might get caught up in it, you know?」
scene.text: Ma Feima looked at Somei’s well-defined face.[\s]The agony welled up in his heart once more, but he was used to it by now. This woman had been like that since childhood—always ruthlessly calm and unmoving about anything

text.p: [em italic]But it's different now...[/em]
His eyes felt like they were melting, and he was overcome with the urge to say what she had said years ago.

scene.dialog: 「It's impossible.」
scene.text: Suddenly, Su Mei opened her mouth.
scene.dialog: 「I know what you're trying to say, Little Ma. It is written all over your face...」
「You're...」
scene.text: Su Mei shook her head lightly, but it wasn’t as if she was blaming him
scene.dialog: 「You know me better than anyone else in the world, but you still don't get it. I may be a woman who understands your feelings most out of all people on this planet—but not because she loves him or anything like that!」

dialog.p: 「I don't love you, and no one does.
This is not your fault, nor can you change it.」

scene.dialog: 「...Haha.」
scene.text: Ma Feima smiled bitterly.
scene.dialog: 「You want to ask me for something else, right? Don’t you think that if I tell a random lie or two she might just assume things more wholeheartedly.」
「Don't be stupid, Little Ma. You will not fall for it and I shall too!」
scene.text: Su Mei wriggles her fingers. Ma Feima can't help but stare at those beautiful, white hands of his without thinking about it...
scene.dialog: 「There is one thing I respect. Little Ma—you are a good person, and you have long since ceased to be the doll that follows me around」
「There was no need for that to happen, right? Yes. I know you did not make such a mistake or suffer so much more than anything else...」

dialog.p: 「So I don't want you to do anything against your will.
You understand? No matter what I try to make you do, it's your own choice.」
「...But there's a difference between willingly doing it and being happy.
You have to make your own choices.」

scene.text: Ma Feima shrugged. He wasn't happy; he knew that, and she understood it too

dialog.p: 「Fine. I'll give you a choice, and it will be yours to choose from!
What I'm about to tell you is a choice—」

scene.dialog: 「I'll stay.」

text.p: Su Mei looked at the man in front of her. She first glanced into his eyes, then down to him throat and hands...[\s]
Her gaze gave him great joy, and then courage to speak.

scene.dialog: 「My master will come looking for Mei-nee. I can't let her die!」
I won't die.」
scene.text: Su Mei answered casually.

text.p: Ma Feima remained silent. Her words silenced him[\s]
That's because what 『Musou』, also known as “Su Mei” says is always true.

scene.text: She is Su Mei. I won't do anything unconvinced, nor will she make meaningless promises

dialog.p: 「I've been preparing for this since a long time ago. My master expected to come back, after all...
I want you to tell the others about this.」

scene.dialog: 「Are you telling me... to go back and let Zhaoyu know?」
「There's no need for that. I will tell Miss Zhaoyu directly, and she wants you to go farther away than this!」
「If you're looking for Lingshuang, that would be the way... Is it Lingshuang Nee-san?」
「That's right.」
scene.text: Su Mei clapped her hands and laughed.
scene.dialog: 「I'd like you to go north. At the speed of Erebus, we should be there in less than half a month![\s]I want you to find Lingshuang and tell her that Master has returned—」
「I also checked to see if Lingshuang had a sword.」
「Huh? Lingshuang Nee-san's sword is...」

dialog.p: 「That's right. So please check it out!
The whereabouts of the Henxuan Sword are very important, so I want to know everything.」

text.p: Ma Feima hung his head, ruminating on the meaning of Su Mei’s words.
Since Su Mei had said that, he knew there was some sort of intention behind it—but not for him to understand.
However, he had known Su Mei for more than thirty years.
She also knew that clever women didn't like the act of explaining things to men.

scene.dialog: 「Understood. Should I just tell him? Maybe we should bring her back to Nakahara...」

dialog.p: 「Yes, just tell them. It's up to you what we do with the froststorm!
After that, please return to Tianqiu Peak. Let's meet up there!」

scene.dialog: 「Understood.」
scene.text: Ma Feima answered, but he didn’t try to leave.
scene.dialog: 「As for Zhaoyu...」
「I know.」
scene.text: It was as if the man's words conveyed all of her doubts and unease. Her reply had been very accurate—she didn’t need to say anything more than that
Ma Feima replied, then turned his back and prepared to leave.
scene.dialog: 「Little Ma～」
scene.text: Su Mei called out to him from behind.
scene.dialog: 「I'm not deceiving you or dying.」
scene.text: The man remained silent and nodded. That was enough
That night, Ma Feima rode his Erebus into the desert to meet with Su Mei's fifth disciple of Taixuan-ha.
The night was long, but one man and a horse kept running until dawn without rest.

mono.p: The tide rises, the tide falls. [\s]The tide rises, the tide falls. [\s]
The tide rises, the tide falls. [\s]The tide rises, the tide falls.
Before the eyes, is a boundless library of knowledge. [\s]
The vast information contained within, cannot be comprehended by mere mortals.
The tide rises, the tide falls.
Waves of information brushed against the man’s consciousness, again and again, again and again. [\s]
He tried his best to remain clear-headed.
Within the sea, limitless amounts of information floated and sank.
What the man could grasp, were but mere planktons.
And among the information obtained by hand, there was very little usable; [\s]
If he didn’t meticulously and carefully pick the right data,
how was it different from a fool to sit on infinite knowledge?
And so he continued to search.
In a place that tends to be unknown, the opponent he once defeated, the deity of "Void Archives,” still covets his physical body.
Infinite knowledge was its bait, and generous gifts are its weapons.
The man knew that "it" was waiting, waiting for his guard to slip.
But he was still searching.
The search will not stop.
All this was to save that person——
For this, does hard work mean anything? [\s]
Does danger mean anything? [\s]
Does time mean anything?
Eternity… Does it mean anything?
The tide rises, the tide falls. [\s]The tide rises, the tide falls. [\s]
The tide rises, the tide falls. [\s]The tide rises, the tide falls.
The will of the man never wavered.
The tide rises——
He was still searching.

scene.title: 真気
scene.text: The sun rose high in the sky, and life returned to Raksha eyes.
He exhaled deeply and slowly. The sound was quiet, but he couldn't miss the ears of Li Sushang as she tilted her head to look at him
scene.dialog: 「You're awake?」
「Yeah, I'm awake.」

motion.img: 奥托-微笑释然-标准-中景

scene.text: The Raksha responded with a forced smile.
Li Sushang opened and closed her mouth several times, finally unable to hold back any longer as she asked.
scene.dialog: 「Hey, do Raksha sleep with their eyes open?」

motion.img: 素裳-欸真的吗-背手-中景

scene.dialog: 「You fell asleep in the middle of our conversation. But your eyes were open, so I was surprised—you didn't react at all when you waved to me」
scene.text: The girl waved her beautiful white hand in front of the Raksha as she spoke.

dialog.p: 「...No, that's because my consciousness has entered 『Void Archives』.
I had a small question, and needed to find the answer from within. Did that worry you? Sorry for worrying so much...」

scene.dialog: 「I have to focus my mind. These catalysts are powerful, but they also come with a certain price for power...」
「『Void Archives』 has great principles hidden behind it, and explorations are always in danger. If you don't focus on something else your consciousness might be swallowed up by『Void Archives』...」

「There's also the third Divine Key of Shicksal, 『Judgment of Shamash』. It has enough power to destroy mountains and seas as well—but it always recoiled when unleashing holy fire; its owner himself would lose his life」

「...The same goes for 『Abyss Flower』, who used it to treat you. Even I can't completely suppress that strange power of yours...I once healed myself with this thing before but as a result there was an aftereffect left behind by the wound—an internal injury in what is commonly called your language」
「Even now, there are times when I get old and young again. That means it'll take me a few dozen days to recover...」
「Internal injuries...?」

motion.img: 素裳-悲伤目下-背手-中景

scene.dialog: （Rejuvenated due to the disturbance in her spirit... I feel like i've heard that name somewhere before.）
scene.text: [em italic]...An omen of a stampede?[/em]

motion.img: 素裳-呆滞刺激-背手-中景

scene.text: A thought flashed through his mind, entering Li Sushang head like a seed of the devil.

text.p: All of a sudden, the emotions that surged toward her pressed down on this girl's heart.
Beneath the momentary surprise, regret and pain was a hopelessly intense bloodlust.
Those who have fallen into demon form should die—
That was a rule my mother and master had insistently taught her since childhood—the Taixuan clan’s mission, especially 『Jizaimon』 with no taboo; the only ironclad law.

scene.text: In an instant, 『Blade Mantra』's true form reaches the boundary of Meikyou Mirror. Her right palm suddenly stretches straight out and instantly takes on a Keiken『Rikuu』 shape in her hand—a demon-warding sword that can crush anything―

motion.img: 奥托-微笑自信-摊手-中景

dialog.p: 「No... it's not that scary. It was just a side effect of the catalyst, you know?
I found a solution to that in 『Void Archives』, too.」

motion.img: 素裳-疲惫无神-普通-中景

scene.text: The Raksha reached out and made an elegant gesture.

motion.img: 素裳-欸真的吗-背手-中景

scene.dialog: 「All I need to do is reverse 『Abyss Flower』's power with the output from back then. It would be difficult for me to control its accuracy, but...[\s]My catalysts were made in imitation, so they're less efficient than the real thing. So I need to do a lot of calculations...」
scene.text: The story of Raksha continued, but the words they used became incomprehensible to Sushang.

dialog.p: 「As long as you're cured, that is fine. Please do not let your mind go out of control...
Besides, I can't even imagine what kind of injury you must have suffered. Can a catalyst be used like that?」

scene.text: The Raksha was somewhat dumbfounded, but he thought for a moment before answering.
scene.dialog: 「I won't tell you.」
「Tch.」
scene.text: The Raksha smiled as he watched her pouting, but at the same time his heart ached.[\s]They had very little in common, but being with this Eastern girl always reminded me of 『Her.』.
[em italic]Yeah, it's been so long since I last saw her...[/em]
[em italic]Kallen...[/em]
The Raksha stared at the dry, mountain-colored sand. He could vaguely see a girl smiling with bright eyes in front of him
scene.dialog: 「Hey, great inventor—」

text.p: That's right. She called him that...[\s]
The girl in my memories is standing with her hands behind it. Her silver hair flutters, blown by the gentle breeze

scene.dialog: 「—You see, I have a wish. Don't laugh at me; you will be the only one who can teach it to her!」

text.p: Her voice still lingered in my ears. It was as if time had stopped at that moment, and I would never be able to move forward again[\s]
However, that was more than thirty years ago.

scene.text: Tears instantly welled up in the Raksha’s eyes.
scene.dialog: 「—Missy.」
scene.text: The Raksha wanted to be immersed in reminiscence, but he forced himself back into the real world.

text.p: Getting away from memories of the past would be far more difficult than fighting Void Archives. But no one could possibly understand that, right?

scene.dialog: 「I've been using my catalysts for the past few days, and it has drained me of all serious energy. Some Shinshu martial arts techniques have a way to communicate their true nature... Can you do that?」

mono.p: When Celestials and Shinshu fought, the Raksha had noticed...[\s]
Deep down, 『Maki』 is a difficult energy to understand but should have been the same thing—there were many differences in how it was used between East and West
He found it very strange.
In the West, they see seriousness as a plague and are desperate to escape from its contamination.
What’s more, she had developed a variety of techniques to counteract them[\s]
However, the East Asians have accepted and used it.
I'm using it as a power to strengthen myself.
Compared to Shicksal, Shinshu’s technology is definitely lagging behind.
However, his understanding of Majic was better in the East overall.
...Why did such a difference occur?

scene.dialog: 「Ah, that's...」
scene.text: Li Sushang worried and thought.

dialog.p: 「What you're talking about is a feat. The one where your true feelings are transferred to someone else, right?
Just so you know, it's not like our sword fighting spirit is bad.
It's just... different from other martial arts.」

scene.dialog: 「The founder of the Jizaimon is Phoenix. She traveled all over Japan to defeat evil spirits and monsters that bring calamity upon this world, which was why he detested her most when she went berserk!
That's why her martial arts skills never practice seriously.」
「Oh? This is the first time I've heard of that.」
「After all, you're a foreigner. How should I know? Aha!」
scene.text: She didn’t know what had become the urn for this girl's laughter, but Sushang laughed merrily and continued talking.
scene.dialog: 「That's why— Heheh... We don’t train Naikou or Tanda like the other disciples do. Train your body, and make it a real path for you to follow!」

dialog.p: 「Did you know? The so-called 『Congenitor Ichiki』 essence is the vitality of life.
That's all there is to it. Even among the leaves and petals, true spirit can be found anywhere!」

scene.text: The Raksha smiled. From his point of view, Honkai—or 『Maki』 in the East —seemed more appropriate to call it a “destroyed life force” than something synonymous with vitality; but there was no need for him to correct her opinion
scene.dialog: 「Once you've mastered Edge of Taixuan and the shape of a sword, it absorbs true energy from your surroundings to flow into its meridian. It can be used as large or small waves when necessary—or even in narrow streams without restrictions」
「So compared to other martial arts, the power of Taixuan is stronger but we don't have any serious energy stored in Tanda.」
scene.text: Li Sushang spread her arms wide.
scene.dialog: 「That's why I can’t do the trick.」
「However, according to your explanation」
scene.text: The Raksha thought for a moment.
scene.dialog: 「If you can control the flow of internal merit on your own, wouldn't it be possible to absorb true energy from all over this world and channel that into my meridian?」

motion.img: 素裳-欸真的吗-背手-中景

scene.dialog: 「Huh... Yeah, I think so. But it's impossible for me to do that!」
「I'll tell you.」
「You?」
scene.text: Sushang was surprised.
scene.dialog: 「Can you do it?」

dialog.p: 「I need to explain a little more so that we can match your martial arts system.
There was a difference in understanding of seriousness between the East and West, but it didn’t change its nature.」

scene.dialog: 「I have my brain and 『Void Archives』. Once you understand the true nature of Edge of Taixuan, it won't be hard to figure out how he conveys his qi...」
scene.text: Sushang looked at him in surprise, and then suddenly burst out laughing.
scene.dialog: 「I almost couldn't think of anything to say in response. You Raksha... Oh, right! So you guys are only Shicksal? Then it makes sense that they wouldn’t know any martial arts laws at all」

dialog.p: 「Martial arts can't be passed on to outsiders without permission! It is taboo, after all.
If anyone can learn Edge of Taixuan, Shinshu will be thrown into chaos!」

scene.text: The Raksha was somewhat surprised. Indeed, he hadn't expected Shinshu to have such a rule

motion.img: 奥托-微笑释然-标准-中景

scene.dialog: 「...I'm sorry.」
「Huh? I'm not blaming you or anything... You want to heal your internal injuries, too.」
「All right, young lady. I'll rest for another half month or so and adjust my internal effects before curing myself」

mono.p: He may have said that, but he actually had an idea. It was the main body of Divine Key 「Abyss Flower」 who caused his abnormality[\s]
Using replicas to reverse-engineer them is absolutely impossible on my own. In the end, I have no choice but to rely upon a mysterious Eastern martial art after all...

scene.dialog: 「Geez... You're being way too distant. Just pretending is fine, okay?」
scene.text: Li Sushang unconsciously pouted. Her expression was clouded over, and it hurt to watch her go back and forth like that...

Was it because she’d realized that the Raksha had healed her wounds every day, even after exhausting their own power? The girl wanted to help this man[\s]However, 『Taixuan』 is a secret that absolutely must not be shared with the outside world no matter what.
She hesitated for a while, then suddenly stood up.
scene.dialog: 「Let's get going, Raksha. We must not waste any more time!」

motion.img: 奥托-微笑自信-标准-中景

scene.dialog: 「It's probably only about half a day away, so we should be home by tonight. If I can get my horse to run faster...I could ask Master if he would treat you when they see me—if she turns him down then and there ... When that time comes」
scene.text: Sushang thought about it, bit her lip and spoke firmly.
scene.dialog: 「When that time comes, I won’t listen to my master!」

scene.title: 無上自在

mono.p: When it was still pitch black outside the window, Lingshuang had already woken up;
she always woke up at this time, neither too early nor too late.
After washing and changing clothes with a basin of clean water,
she sat cross-legged on the bed and silently recited Blade Swara. For two hours, she didn’t move.
Then she got up and swept the floor with a broomstick. After the house was cleaned up,
She went to the nearby small market to buy some pancakes and mutton; [\s]
If the water ran out, she'd have to go to the well to get a few buckets of water.
After breakfast, Lingshuang sat down by an old loom, weaving silk.
Once, she was able to knit a satisfactory silk in only one day;
After receiving Sushang, the progress was greatly slowed down. [\s]
Now it takes from four days to a week..
Li Sushang was often curious
about what she will do in her spare time and what techniques she will practice after she goes out.
The two have been together for nearly ten years,
and she still didn't expect that as soon as she left, the master would hand over the time to an old-fashioned loom.
In the beginning, weaving had nothing to do with martial arts.
It was just a cheap way to make a living.
But in Lingshuang's eyes, all the ways are unified, was there no similarity between textiles and martial arts?
Secretly, textiles to Lingshuang have also become a means of tempering swordsmanship and honing martial skills.
The Path of the Sword is all-encompassing, and the sword itself was nothing but something to rely on.
Standing, sitting, lying down, food, clothing, shelter and transportation… everywhere in life there is martial art.
Every gesture is martial arts, and being quiet is also practicing swords. This was "naturally natural."

text.p: And Sushang's master, Empyrea Phoenix's fifth disciple, "Wandering Blade" Lingshuang——[\s]
People called her: The one with the Path, the embodiment of the Sword.

scene.text: Celestial’s most talented disciple was undoubtedly the number one expert in martial arts today. Why had she stayed silent in the Northern Desert for many years?
There are very few people who know, only the same people from the past, but they have made up their minds and would never say a word.

text.p: As for Lingshuang, she just chanted Blade Swara day after day, spinning silk. [\s]
No one knows where she came from, and no one knows where she went.
…In this way, on the eighth day when Li Sushang went out for her Sword Trial, [\s]
Lingshuang sat in front of the loom and suddenly heard the sound of a horse's hooves in the distance.

scene.title: 旅の仲間

mono.p: The two best horses of the Golden Sand Gang pulled a cart along the desert.
Li Sushang leaned against the edge and began humming a tune in high spirits.
[Raksha! You should stop your sorceries. It’s very refreshing to feel the wind blow across your face every once in a while.]
The fast moving cart drew up a strong wind, leaving Sushang’s braids flowing through the air like two dark rivers.
On the other side, the Raksha shielded himself with an invisible air barrier. [\s]
In the domain created by the relic [Void Archives], the man’s hair remained unmoved, as was his expression.

scene.mono: [Are you not hot?]

mono.p: [Yep! But that’s how deserts are.]

scene.mono: The Raksha was about to shield the girl too, but stopped as he heard her response.

mono.p: [Are you mad? Oh sorry. It’s just… That carriage you conjured was a bit...]

text.p: While Sushang wasn’t so shocked by the tricks the Raksha pulled the day before,
she couldn’t say the same now.
The carriage was round and bumpy, and the bright orange color stuck out like a sore thumb.
The Raksha had said that this was a western specialty called a [pumpkin] as he grinned at it.

scene.text: Li Sushang was embarrassed. She’d rather walk than ride that kind of carriage.

mono.p: [Besides, aren’t you injured? You probably shouldn’t be casting magic right now…
Just sit tight!]
Sushang was truly concerned for the remnants of the Raksha’s Ki.
However, the Raksha appeared to harbor a heavy grudge against the wind.
Even if he agreed to ride this scrappy carriage, he was determined to remain as elegant as possible, his hair undeterred from its place.
[...If you’re so powerful, how were you captured?
I don’t get it.]
[Captured? I was invited to be that Eagle’s guest.]
[...As a guest?]

scene.text: Li Sushang blinked.
scene.mono: [...A guest in jail?]

mono.p: [It’s a strange place indeed.]

scene.text: The Raksha stroked his chin, deep in thought.
scene.mono: [But that Eagle told me: [Everything here is mine, and you can give everything that is yours to me. Please, come out of the carriage and follow my servants. No need for formalities.] …Is that not an invitation?]

mono.p: [...You seem to have a misunderstanding with the Shenzhou language.]
Li Sushang scratched her head.
[Who talks like that normally? What’d he actually say?]
[This place is mine.
You’re mine too.
Get out
and follow them.
Don’t try anything funny.]

scene.text: The Raksha imitated “Eagle’s” voice with frightening accuracy.

mono.p: [... Raksha, your interpretation was quite… kind.]
[That’s not my problem… Your language is too complicated.]

scene.text: Li Sushang stared at the man, raising an eyebrow. Was he playing her for a fool?
He’s pretty and all, but he didn’t seem like one to play by the rules.

mono.p: [Geez, it’s so dangerous to talk to you.
It’s like everything you say is a trap waiting for me to embarrass myself.]
[Why don’t you tell me more about the Schicksal Sect?]
[Huh?]

scene.text: The Raksha’s pretty face slid off his palms and hit his wrist with a dull thud, causing him to shoot up and rub his eyes:

mono.p: [No no… That takes too much brain power.]
[Aye.]

scene.text: Li Sushang’s face was full of disappointment.

mono.p: [Then give me a few days to think it over…
and then I’ll tell you about it.]
[But it’ll be a while before we get home. It’d be so boring if we didn’t say anything.]

scene.text: The Raksha fell silent for a few moments:

mono.p: [Why don’t you tell me a story? How about that Celestial?
I remember you saying that: you were well established with Phoenix?]
[That’d be my mom and my master. I… I haven’t actually seen the Celestial before.]
Sushang tried to remember.
[Really, I’ve never seen her before. Neither my parents nor my master brings her up very often.
Everything I know about Master Phoenix comes from my wet nurse.]

scene.title: 剣神？

mono.p: [She said that Master Phoenix was the only true Celestial in this world. Immortal and undying.]
[They say that she was all powerful and beyond the three realms. With her hands she could turn Shenzhou over, and with her sword she could bring peace to the lands.]
[As the protector of Shenzhou, she’d slain one of many demons.]
[The imperial court has named her as the Celestial,
but she doesn’t have a care for politics, nor is she concerned about dynastical change.
Every emperor who’s about to ascend will visit her at Mount Taixuan.]
[They say that rulers who are graced by her presence will live a long and fruitful life to see their kingdom prosper.]
[And the ones who couldn’t would either pass away unexpectedly or have their dynasty taken from them.]
[—That’s about it. There was more, but I forgot.]
[Hmm…]

scene.mono: The Raksha observed Li Sushang’s expression.
[Those are merely empty praises. Have there been actual accounts?]

mono.p: [Actual accounts… Slaying the demonic cult leader Yan Shiluo? Or killing the demons on Li Island?
Those are dubious tales.
What kind of examples do you want to hear? My wet nurse didn’t tell me much…]
[For instance…]

scene.mono: The Raksha’s gaze suddenly narrowed.

mono.p: [If the Celestial really is as all powerful as they claim, transcending the three realms, have they ever brought the dead back to life before?]
[Bring the dead… Back to life?]

scene.mono: [Yes.]
The Raksha said quietly.

mono.p: The man stared at Li Sushang, but he wasn’t looking at her. It was as if there was something giant next to the girl that was glowing with heat and did the same to his eyes.
[I, I don’t remember…]
Sushang avoided his fierce stare and glanced at the coffin. Suddenly, she had an epiphany:
[You’re trying to revive someone, aren’t you?]
[Ah.]
[Yes.]
The Raksha opened his mouth and let out a meaningless sound.
He stopped after, his eyes dimming. The light and heat they once contained dissipated in the air.
Once again, he became the foreigner who would sometimes tell a few jokes or look off sadly into the distance.
[That’s right! That’s why you’re trying to find the Celestial… You want her to revive someone?]
[Yes.]
He lowered his eyes.
[Isn’t it rather common for ordinary people to have a wish like that?]
The golden-haired man smiled gently.
[I want her to come back to life.
It’s very simple, but it’s often the most simple wishes that are the hardest to fulfill.]

scene.mono: [Nineteen years. It’ll be nineteen years after four days.]

mono.p: [Sigh]

scene.mono: Li Sushang wanted to say something, but she couldn’t find anything to say, so she only sighed:
[That’s a long time.]

mono.p: She was only fifteen years old, and she hadn’t been loved for long by anybody else nor had she loved anyone, so she couldn’t understand the passion that permeated the Raksha’s words.
[Nineteen years…
It all happens in a flash. I have enough time, and so does she.]

scene.mono: The Raksha brushed his finger across the coffin.
[Once we see the Celestial, she’ll come back.]

text.p: For a second, Li Sushang thought he was talking about her.

scene.text: However, the Raksha’s emerald-like eyes were focused on the coffin, completely unaware of her presence.
To see the Raksha like this… Li Sushang suddenly felt as if she didn’t want to disappoint him.

mono.p: [em italic]([Could the Celestial really bring that person back to life?])[/em]

scene.mono: The girl suddenly shivered.

mono.p: She never thought the Raksha had that much hope for the Celestial. At first, she was just going to point him to her master and then let her master help him see the Celestial. It was so simple.
However, Li Sushang had now wandered into another person’s wish by her own accords.
A sentence that she’d never paid much care to before was now tugging at her heartstrings. [\s]
She just hoped… Ah, she wasn’t sure herself.
[She will… Uh… She will come back!]

scene.mono: The girl said with little confidence.
[It’s just… Raksha. When we go see my master… and then… When you see the Celestial… You’ll…]

mono.p: She stuttered, trying to cheer the Raksha up,
but the guilt in her heart caused her voice to get quieter and quieter.
[You’ll definitely… Get what you want.]
The corners of his mouth formed a faint smile.
[Thank you, Sushang.]
Sushang sat there, shocked, and then realized she had a large dumb grin on face.
She pouted and looked away.

scene.dialog: [Hmm?]
scene.text: The clattering of hooves came closer.
From the edge of her vision, a man and horse came closer and closer toward the same direction that Sushang was heading.
scene.dialog: ([Hmm? Master has other friends?])
scene.text: She saw the rider’s face clearly now: it was a giant man of yellow hair.
Li Sushang suddenly felt as if she recognized him even though she hadn’t seen anyone else for the past ten years.

mono.p: As if by coincidence, the man glanced at the Raksha and Li Sushang too.
The momentary glance, however, suddenly stopped as it turned into a glare.
[Motherfucker.]

scene.text: The brute closed his eyes, but opened them quickly.
His face was a myriad of emotions: sorrow, frustration, and pure joy.
He waved his hand, and despite it being empty, a light shot forth from it— !
Schwing!
The ropes that connected the cart to the horse were severed, and they ran off into the dunes in the distance.
The cart leaned forward and planted into the sand, tipping forward before falling back.
Sushang moved quickly and stabilized herself with the [Gleaming Lotus] move of the Edge of Taixuan’s Guard Form.
She reached for the Raksha but was met with an invisible wall that cushioned her bottom. It was the invisible barrier that the Raksha had opened.
They both stumbled a bit but didn’t fall.
Faced with this sudden turn of events, Li Sushang had not yet calmed down.

text.p: Reason being that she knew that move.
The move that the man launched was [Ripstone] of the Edge of Taixuan’s [Wrath Form].

scene.dialog: [em italic][(Who is he? And why can he use the Edge of Taixuan?)][/em]
scene.text: And yet, there was something that shocked her even more.
—The man’s hands were empty when he launched his strike.
[em italic]To bring forth a sword from formless Ki.[/em]

text.p: —Isn’t that the highest of the five Taixuan Essences?
The one that, from her knowledge, was only learnt by her master…

scene.text: [Eminence]?!

scene.title: 実力試し

motion.img: 奥托-严肃-标准-远景（棺材）

scene.text: Ma Feima was staring at this strange pair.

motion.img: 奥托-严肃-标准-中景（棺材）

scene.text: One of them was a blond Raksha.

mono.p: He was tall and slender with well-defined features, but just looking at him didn’t seem to be anything special on the inside. His breathing lacked any basics or his martial arts seemed average[\s]
However, Ma Feima knew better. This person was different from how he looked; it wasn’t an easy opponent to deal with
When I used my swordsmanship to take a look, the true movements of his body were extremely unnatural.[\s]
It's like the inside of a strange eight-stringed sutra is empty.
And yet, the sanyo sanin in my hand has such force that it feels like I’m going to go berserk.
This Raksha had a very strange reaction when he stopped the carriage with his sword earlier, too.
He hadn’t moved his arms and legs, but he was completely unaffected by the overturned carriage—as if floating in midair.

scene.dialog: （...Does the Raksha Kingdom have that kind of divine power?）

mono.p: Ma Feima couldn’t believe it.
Was the blond-haired man hiding that he was an extremely skilled user of Uchiko? Or perhaps a suspicious martial arts wielder. Though it had to be one or another, Ma Feima thought
And both of his eyes...
He has a very young face, but his eyes are so deep that they don't match him at all...

scene.mono: It looked at hell,[\s]It was a bittersweet taste,[\s]They were the eyes of someone who had overcome blood abyss.

mono.p: I could hear whispers urging me to be careful in my horse-hitting brain.[\s]This Raksha is someone who can kill me.
[em italic]（Really? ...Is this man capable of doing it, or...）[/em]
A heavy pain and craving swirled in my chest.
Ma Feima closed his eyes.[\s]
Death.[\s]
Like flowers blooming in the night air, a stimulus known as death spread through her heart and quickly drowned out all cold.
[em italic]（Very well... Let's see what you can do!）[/em]

motion.img: 奥托-严肃-标准-远景（棺材）

mono.p: That’s what Ma Feima told himself.[\s]
The whisper accepted his words and suppressed the urge for now.
Then, she waited for her master's order as if unable to wait any longer.
[em italic]（This woman is...）[/em]

scene.text: She was the reason why Ma Feima had laid a hand on her.
It was a girl dressed in bluish-colored clothes. There's something familiar about her innocent eyes that still look like they belonged to someone else...
Likewise, he recognized the sword she was holding. He’d only caught a glimpse of its hilt at first glance—but Ma Feima had confidence that it would never make any mistakes in his vision
It is a sword of honor granted to seven disciples by Phoenix, and it serves as the foundation for Taixuana 「Ken'i」.

And that wasn't all. When the carriage shook violently, she tried to get into position with her sword Joren; it was only for a moment—but Ma Feima could clearly tell who this girl had been studying under

dialog.p: [em italic]（...A genuine swordsmanship!
It's not Taixuan Shinken, nor is it the sword of pure memory...）[/em]

scene.text: Ma Feima immediately realized that this girl must be Lingshuang’s pupil
scene.dialog: [em italic]（Haha. I see! If only that hadn't happened... How did he inherit the true power of a sword?）[/em]
scene.text: Even if it was something that Su Mei desperately tried to stop, Lingshuang didn't mind at all.

text.p: Ma Feima was suddenly happy.
From this half-assed Taixuan Sword Form, he could vaguely make out the elegant figure of a woman who had vanished twenty years ago

scene.text: [em italic]A-All those years that have passed...[/em]

text.p: Those years were both nostalgic and heartbreaking to him.

motion.img: 奥托-严肃-标准-远景（棺材）

text.p: Just then, the Raksha opened his mouth.
It was a very quiet voice, but it had been enough to ruin the faint emotion of Ma Feima

scene.dialog: 「Be careful with Sushang.」
scene.text: The Raksha spoke to the girl.

dialog.p: [em italic]（This man doesn't speak Shinshu fluently. He sounds like someone from Zhongyuan...
How did Lingshuang get to know someone like this...?）[/em]

motion.img: 奥托-微笑奸-标准-远景（棺材）

scene.dialog: 「That man is trying to obtain your sword.」
「Huh? My kenjou!」
scene.text: Their eyes met.

motion.img: 奥托-标准-标准-远景（棺材）

scene.text: But one of them turned his gaze downward, and the other averted it.

dialog.p: [em italic]（Oh... So you saw right through me?
This Raksha Demon seems pretty good.）[/em]

text.p: The scarred man couldn’t help but smile broadly.[\s]
The scars of the sword on his face turned red, as if a flame were burning.
My curiosity grew stronger again, replaced by an uncontrollable urge.
I hear another whisper in my ear. 「This man is the one who can kill me.」

dialog.p: [em italic]（I’ve made up my mind! All right, come at me now. Death is nothing to be afraid of—
Can this man do it?）[/em]

scene.dialog: [em italic]（You should be able to tell if you try!）[/em]
scene.text: —That was the decision he preferred most.

scene.title: 天•地•螺旋

mono.p: The yellow sands roared under the fiery sun.
Waves of air bellowed across the land, bringing with it an unbearable heat.
However, Sushang felt like she was freezing from the murderous aura that emanated from the man.

scene.text: The man was of an unknown age and kept a stubble. A striking scar scrawled across his face like a crimson lightning bolt, only to abruptly end at his lower jaw… It was as if it were falling forever.
If one looked closely, the man had an innumerable number of scars on his body.

Without them, he would surely be a handsome man, but those red branches that spread across his body didn’t leave him as a frightening demon. On the contrary, it added to a sort of nobleness about him.

motion.img: 奥托-严肃-标准-远景（棺材）

scene.dialog: [Sushang, be careful.]
scene.text: The Raksha slowly came down from the carriage and carefully placed the coffin on the sand.

motion.img: 奥托-微笑自信-标准-远景（棺材）

scene.dialog: [He wants your sword.]
[What? My Xuanyuan?]
scene.text: She was confused at first, but quickly connected the dots.
Sushang stared at the strange man and noticed that his glowing eyes were focused on the Raksha.
Suddenly, the man laughed.

text.p: The corners of his mouth turned upwards, moving along with that red scar of his. It looked a little unnatural, but he let out a hearty laugh.
By the time he was finished, the man somehow looked gentle:

scene.dialog: [Hey little girl! Are you Lingshuang’s disciple?]
[I’m not telling you!]
scene.text: Her anger widened her eyes to the size of saucers:
scene.dialog: [What’s with you?! Can’t give me a heads up before you wanna talk?!]
[Looks like it.]
scene.text: Instead of getting angry, the man laughed. He reached out his hand and pointed at the Raksha.
scene.dialog: [Apologies, I have a couple things to say, and then I’ll get right to the fighting— mhm, I want to fight that Raksha demon.]
[Huh… Huhhhhhh… What are you trying to do?!]
scene.text: Sushang quickly returned to the Raksha’s side.
scene.dialog: [He’s not going to fight you, he… What are you trying to do? Why are you trying to fight?]

dialog.p: [I’m sorry, little girl, for breaking your carriage.
As compensation, I’ll let Erebus take you the rest of the way.]

scene.text: The man cracked his joints as he spoke to Sushang:
scene.dialog: [The Raksha demon’s actually not wrong. Yes, I want your Xuanyuan sword, but I won’t take it from you by force… At least not right now. Tell me, little girl, that is your sword, yes?]
[Of course it’s mine!]
[Heh, no wonder you looked familiar, you’re Lingshuang’s disciple after all. Very well. By seniority, you should call me Senior Uncle.
After I get done with goldie over here we can catch up. I was just on my way to see your Master too.]
[He won’t fight you.]
[Aye, he’ll fight cause that’s all he will know how to do.]
scene.text: The man looked the Raksha up and down:
scene.dialog: [Cause I want to.]
[You—]

mono.p: —Suddenly

text.p: The sky was encompassed by killing intent, but disappeared just as quickly. [\s]
There didn’t seem to be any traces of the man left in the world.

scene.text: Li Sushang looked at the Raksha, who was as calm as ever.
That’s right, the Raksha wouldn’t understand. Only she knew that this meant their opponent had entered the Blade Mantra state.

mono.p: The abandonment of all useless emotions. The abandonment of all meaningless thoughts.
With no greed or anger, no obsessions or hate, still like water with no dust, like a clear mirror and nothingness.
This is the Taixuan Blade Mantra, created from Empyrea Phoenix's legendary arts!

scene.text: There’s no doubt about it: the strange man in front of them was the disciple to the Celestial herself, the sole man in the Seven Disciples of Taixuan:

text.p: [Tireless Courser] Ma Feima.

scene.text: Sushang remembered meeting him at the Issen Villa when she was younger. The way he carried himself as a peerless co-leader of the School of Taixuan was unforgettable.
[em italic]…… Did she have a chance against someone on the level of the Six Great Sects?[/em]

motion.img: 奥托-标准-标准-远景（棺材）

scene.dialog: [Raksha… Step back, let me handle this.]
scene.text: Sometime in between, the girl had been overwhelmed by the man’s presence, leaving her voice as quiet as a mosquito.
scene.dialog: [Okay.]
scene.text: The Raksha nodded since he had no intention of fighting to begin with.

text.p: He took a couple of steps back and looked at Ma Feima.
He said nothing but looked at Ma Feima with an empty stare.

scene.dialog: [...Pussy.]
scene.text: The man sighed and said to Sushang:
scene.dialog: [You’re not going to kill him?]
[Hasn’t Lingshuang taught you that the duty of the Taixuan lineage is to slaughter any and all demons?]
[He hasn’t fallen to that point yet.]

[Haha, it’s bound to happen. By the way he’s doing things, he’ll become much more evil than a demon. Aye, why are you trying to cover for him? The powers that this Raksha demon’s hiding… Heh, it’s far more than anything you can imagine.]
[...Oh well, who am I to tell you what to do.]
scene.text: Li Sushang looked at the towering man and held her ground.
scene.dialog: [Aye, it’d be way easier if you just killed him]
scene.text: Ma Feima shrugged.
