dialog.p: [Fine. If you’re so intent on protecting him… Then I’ll let you start.
Not ready? I’ll let you take as long as you want to get back to prime condition.
Remember, fight this battle with the resolve to kill me. I won’t hold back.]

scene.dialog: [Why do we have to fight?!]
scene.text: He stared at her and smiled.
That’s it. He’d said everything already, so why say anything else? Ma Feima had already decided, and whatever he decided, he will do.
The girl bit her lip and despite being unsatisfied, complied with his instructions.

mono.p: This wasn’t some common rabble.
There was very little chance of winning even if she gave her all.
After all— he was the Sixth Sword of Taixuan, an expert who could rival her master!
[em color=#FAFAD2](Aiya, I have to duel again only a couple of days after dueling for the first time in my life?)[/em]
Even worse, her opponent was one of the strongest seven in these lands …
[em color=#FAFAD2](It’s like the books say. Once you enter these lands, there’s no getting out.)[/em]
Li Sushang felt all of those thoughts flow through her and turned them into her will for fighting.
Her Mind Lake was calm and waveless, it was clean and clear like a mirror.
This was a state even higher than Ma Feima’s [Still Water]:
Blade Mantra · Clear Mirror.

scene.title: 天•地•螺旋2
scene.text: She raised her hands, placing them in the formation of the starting strike of Edge of Taixuan’s [Opening Form · Onslaught].
scene.dialog: [Heh].
scene.text: Ma Feima scoffed, either in joy or disgust:
scene.dialog: [Come then!]
scene.text: His form disappeared even before he finished his sentence.
No, it wasn’t gone, just so fast to the point that not even the eye could detect it.
There was only the sudden breeze, the vibrating air, and the impending killing intent that indicated his presence.
In an instant, Ma Feima appeared in front of the Raksha and Sushang. He pushed his palm outward, a strike so ordinary but was one of the opening strikes of the Edge of Taixuan —
Wrath Form · Roiling Gale!

mono.p: If it were the Sushang from three days ago, she may not have reacted in time.

scene.mono: However, she has since improved a lot.

mono.p: A mirrored heart, illuminates all.
Ma Feima’s actions fell into her mirrored heart, shimmering and shaking, and all of sudden, they slowed down.
In the split second of emptiness, she could not only detect his moves, but also formulate the most optimal counterattack.
Without a second thought, Sushang struck with her right hand.
The cloth bag with the Xuanyuan sword bounced into the air,
twisting until it faced the man’s incoming palm.
[em italic]Stop your attack![/em]
That’s what Li Sushang hoped.

scene.text: If not, then this legendary armament will surely slice his hand in half.

text.p: However, the man’s strike didn’t slow a single bit.
It was as if he wasn’t facing a legendary weapon, but a bamboo stick.

dialog.p: [Remember, the Wrath Form and Switch Form are alike.
You are the one striking, not your sword, so do not be so insistent on the form!]

scene.text: The man lifted his pinky and stopped the Xuanyuan.
With three fingers, he deflected the blade behind him.
[em italic color=#FAFAD2](Switch Form [Selene’s Heron]... how is that possible?)[/em]
How was it so fast and precise….
How was it possible to use it like that…?
scene.dialog: [Learn and adapt! Why are you still on Opening Form? Too slow!]
scene.text: In an instant, that hand became a palm strike once again, flying towards her!
The girl raised her arm to guard, but it was too late.
scene.dialog: [Hngh—!]
scene.text: A force, both soft and hard, struck her. She opened her mouth, the air around her compressing into a sonic wave propelling her backwards.
That strike was still Wrath Form — [Roiling Gale]!
Her young body slammed to the sand, and even though the soft ground had absorbed the brunt of the impact, Sushang still let out a tiny cry.

motion.img: 素裳-战损-虚弱-空手-中景

scene.text: Blood flowed out of her orifices, and her head was spinning — The place that he struck her wasn’t hurting, but she was in no condition to fight any longer.

mono.p: To turn strength into weakness by using the object of highest defense against their opponent.
— Edge of Taixuan, Wrath Form [Roiling Gale] , it was a strange strike that used Ki to induce a strong vibration.
Having taken the full force of the blast, Sushang’s body wasn’t harmed, but her insides were scrambled.
The brunt of the damage was in her brain, where Sushang could still feel the vibrations.

scene.dialog: [Ah… Ahhhh]

motion.img: 素裳-战损-虚弱-单手-近景

scene.text: Sushang tried to stand but felt the world spinning.
The sky and the Earth, and the blue and the yellow all converged into a swirl.
Swirl —
Thud.
The girl kneeled on the ground, blood flowing out of her eyes, blurring her vision.
She tried to look in front of her,

text.p: but inside the twisted world,
the only thing she caught were those emerald eyes of the Raksha.

scene.title: 霧と火

text.p: A single blow.[\s]
Ma Feima won in a single blow, but there was still no hint of joy on his face.

motion.img: 奥托-严肃-标准-远景（棺材）

text.p: I could feel the impact through my palm.
Ma Feima instinctively looked over at the Raksha, but he was disappointed in his lack of reaction.

motion.img: 奥托-严肃-标准-近景（棺材）

text.p: No reaction... That's right.
The Raksha man was staring at Sushang, as if he were looking into a stone or grain of sand.

scene.text: [em italic]Why didn’t he show any reaction when the girl had been attacked right in front of him, bleeding all over and collapsed?[/em]
[em italic]Even if it was someone I didn't know... Would she be able to stay completely unfazed after witnessing such a serious injury?[/em]
scene.dialog: [em italic]（—What a boring man.）[/em]

mono.p: Feelings of disappointment washed over me like a rainstorm.
Emotions like cold rain poured down from head to foot, enveloping Ma Feima in its chill.
Ma Feima didn’t like this blond man—it was an inherent rejection and disgust.
If I had to describe it, these Raksha were like ice floating and isolated outside the world.
She didn't need anything, nor did she care about it. Even if the world were to be destroyed—it would drift on forever
On the other hand, Ma Feima—is like a flame.
The world was smoke, and Ma Feima were burning flame.
This world exists precisely because he is burning.
Intense emotions, explosive impulses and destructive battles were what made him exist.
And then, she would find a faint fragment of herself in that hollow and hazy existence.
Those fragments are the meaning of life.

scene.text: Ma Feima picked up the girl’s sword and stared at her closely.

text.p: Without a doubt, it was the real old sword.
It was a treasure given to seven disciples by Phoenix.

dialog.p: [em italic]（Where did you get it?
...Lingshuang Nee-san's sword should have broken. What about this one?）[/em]

scene.dialog: [em italic]（Mei, did you know? No wonder she told me to be careful...）[/em]
[em italic]（What am I supposed to do?）[/em]
scene.text: Still holding the sword, Ma Feima walked over to a kneeling girl. She was walking slowly but firmly

motion.img: 素裳-战损-虚弱-空手-中景

scene.text: The girl who’d lost to him was far more interesting than the skill he had no intention of fighting.
She was also a flame. A newborn spark, and she wasn't sure how to burn it
scene.dialog: [em italic]（That's too bad...）[/em]

text.p: Ma Feima knew his power well. He had almost suppressed the inner strength, and though he was gravely injured at times it would not be life-threatening for him
Even so, it shouldn't be a wound I can ignore.

dialog.p: [em italic]（Too bad—with this girl's skill, she should have been able to block the opening of a sword and an earthquake with enough experience...
If my opponent hadn't been me, I would never have lost so easily.）[/em]

text.p: He trained his swordsmanship to the 「Meikyou」 border at age sixteen...
Of the Seven Swords, only Lingshuang had mastered 「Taixuan」 at thirteen years old.

scene.dialog: [em italic]（No wonder Lingshuang Nee-san took her as a pupil. When the time comes, this girl might become one of 「Kenshin」's students too）[/em]
scene.text: Besides... she is blessed with good fortune. She was born a woman, and has the best conditions for training her swordsmanship in Taixuanōki (Vengeance of Void).

scene.title: 霧と火2

motion.img: 素裳-战损-虚弱-空手-中景

scene.dialog: 「However, the world is a cruel place. Daughter...」
scene.text: Ma Feima stood a full body away from her. He trembled as he watched the girl stand up, supporting his knees with both hands without any surprise whatsoever

dialog.p: 「Being energetic was a good thing, but she couldn't beat me.
Don't push yourself. You have a wonderful future ahead of you!」

motion.img: 素裳-战损-顽强-空手-中景

scene.dialog: 「I... won't lose.」

text.p: Blood dripped from the girl's nose.
Li Sushang looked up, her eyes unfocused.

motion.img: 素裳-战损-顽强-邀战-中景
素裳-战损-顽强-标准-近景

mono.p: How many times had Ma Feima seen such an expression on his face?
For twenty years, a large number of people had come after his life.
Many heroes, great men and excellent youngsters challenged him.
Most of them were like this.
Even without a slight chance of victory, he hadn’t given up until the very end—he was betting on that momentary possibility where life and death were separated.

scene.dialog: [em italic]（Struggling? ...Yeah, I guess so.）[/em]

mono.p: However, Ma Feima did not dislike it.
On the contrary, she’d been enthralling him.
After all... in this mist-shrouded world, Ma Feima was alone.
Even if it was just a one-time connection, even though we would never meet again in the future—[\s]
Watching the challenger burn his own life and try to prove that he exists, it feels like I've been acknowledged by my world.
Ma Feima felt as if a mist in the shape of such people would envelop him—a feeling that he was alive.
That was why he’d always given his opponent an opportunity to fight.
That's why,[\s]
He had always hoped that he would be killed—

scene.text: In front of the girl, a fence fell without making any sound.

motion.img: 素裳-战损-虚弱-空手-远景

scene.dialog: 「Pick it up.」
scene.text: Ma Feima said.
scene.dialog: 「Without a sword—you can’t fight me.」
「I won't go easy on you. This time, use all your strength to kill me! Understand? Pick it up!!」
scene.text: Sushang slowly lowered its head. A drop of blood fell onto the old sword, making a small sound like phoenix cries
scene.dialog: 「You... Why are you the Sword God?」
scene.text: She coughs up the blood in her mouth. At that point, she can finally speak clearly enough for me to understand what I'm saying...
scene.dialog: 「Ha—Haha!」

dialog.p: 「You think that's the Sword God? Haha, you overestimate me.
Daughter, do you have any idea how much of a boundary the Sword God has? Most martial arts practitioners can't even touch it for their entire lives.」

scene.dialog: 「Only geniuses like Master Phoenix and Lingshuang Nee-san would be able to master such things as divine beings—daughter, my technique is not that of the Sword God; it’s sword will.」
「Take a look.」
scene.text: He reached out his hand, and a greatsword red as flame suddenly appeared.
scene.dialog: 「This is my sword, 『Redsweord』.」
「The Henxuan Swords are held by our seven disciples one at a time. This sword is synchronized with the Void Blade, and it can use skillful techniques in response to changes of its will...」

「『Redsweord』 can control light. I'll be able to change this sight and invisibility with just my own feelings, so normally it doesn’t show much of anything but when the time comes you transmute your swordsmanship」

motion.img: 素裳-战损-虚弱-标准-远景

text.p: Sushang picked up the sword and stared at it.[\s]
If what Ma Feima said was true, then why didn't his own sword change?

scene.text: Could that absentmindedness be the true form of swordsmanship?
scene.dialog: 「Yes... Your sword is still in its original form. In other words, you haven't mastered the will of your blade yet? If it learns how to wield a tsurugi that can change shape as well!」
「I see... So you haven't been able to do it yet.」

mono.p: It was a little disappointing... But that must have been the truth.
I swallowed the bitter blood in my mouth. The sense of loss, embarrassment and frustration were all consumed by it together with sadness...
Don't worry. This is your second trial, right?

scene.text: Li Sushang straightened her back and held the sword in hand.

motion.img: 素裳-战损-振作-单手-远景

dialog.p: 「You... have a sword, too.
That's... fair!」

text.p: Her body was still trembling. She couldn't stop—especially her legs, which were shaking all over the place[\s]
But her eyes... Her gaze is powerful. It's—

scene.text: They were the eyes common to those burning.

motion.img: 素裳-战损-顽强-单手-远景

scene.dialog: 「Jizaimon... Li Sushang, please take care of him again.」
「This is...a trial!」
scene.text: Ma Feima stroked the red scar on his nose. He could feel a faint warmth in her fingertips
[em italic]Yeah. This loneliness, this kind of firelight...[/em]
He's still alive.
scene.dialog: 「Listen carefully.」
scene.text: Ma Feima said.
scene.dialog: 「There's only one skill I can use: Open Sword Mountain Disintegration.」

scene.title: 一撃に返す•壱

mono.p: [Live well.]
The voice echoed in Li Sushang's Mind Lake.
The lake was calm as usual, everything around was Still Water.
[Make sure you live well.]
The voice reverberated within the Mind Lake.
A soft breeze caressed the body, everything was Dustless.
[Promise me…]
The sound… reverberates.
The Mind Lake is like a Clear Mirror, illuminating all of heaven and earth.
Why did Blade Sanction fail? No more doubts. [\s]
Why did Blade Sanction fail? No more regrets. [\s]
Why did Blade Sanction fail? No more worries.
Throw away all the troubles, just concentrate on this strike. [\s]
Use the sword— the tool for killing,[\s]
With sword techniques— the skills of killing.
Kill the enemy and live.
Sushang's thoughts are nothing more than that.
How ironic, the purpose was so simple. [\s]
Yet she detoured a long, long way.
Holding the hilt with her fingers, she felt relieved.
This ancient sword Xuanyuan was her only support at the moment.
Wiping off the blood from the corner of her eye and wiping off the foam from her mouth.
The girl held a sword in her hand.
She didn’t rake up any sword stances yet, but,
Opening, Switch, Guard, Wrath.

scene.mono: Odious Crescent, [\s]Ocean Breaker, [\s]Onslaught.

mono.p: Sailing Eagle, Soaring Falcon, [\s]Raining Swift, Sparrow’s Roost, [\s]Shadow Hawk, Selene’s Heron. [\s]
Gaunt Willow, Gentle Orchid, Girded Bamboo, [\s]Gray Chrysanthemum, Gleaming Lotus, Green Pines.[\s]
Ripstone, Roaring Thunder, Railing Blitz, Rockslide, Riven Dust, Roiling Gale.
These are the four forms and twenty-one stances of Taixuan’s Blade Form. Their names flashed across her mind as the muscle memories of each form passed through her body.

scene.dialog: [Listen.]
scene.text: Although the enemy was close, the sound seems to be coming from far, far away.
scene.dialog: “I will only use one trick: Wrath Form • Rockslide.”
scene.text: Li Sushang remained silent.
scene.dialog: "There is only one move: Wrath Form • Rockslide. I won't keep my hand, let me see your response."

text.p: Should I apply?
Ma Feima's instructions slipped through Sushang's mind, and she didn't care.

scene.text: After all, everything comes down to this one strike.

scene.title: 一撃に返す•弐

mono.p: [Redsweord] -[\s]
The sword was five feet and nine inches long, and the ancient sword Xuanyuan was transformed by Blade Sanction,
This is Ma Feima’s exclusive sword, with none like it in the world.
[Rockslide] -[\s]
Taixuan’s Wrath Form’s fourth style, with two of the left hand’s fingers held back, as the Guard Form, it’s called [Gentle Orchid];
The right hand holds the blade on par with the shoulder. The blade strikes with an inch of strength, yet its power can crush mountains and shatter the ground.

text.p: However, this move has a weakness. [\s]
Even with Ma Feima's superb cultivation foundation, there’s a brief windup time between forming the stance and launching the strike.

scene.text: Ordinary martial arts masters couldn't find, and capture this momentary flaw.

text.p: However, as a cultivator of Taixuan’s Blade Mantra, Li Sushang had a chance to catch that gap. [\s]
...But Ma Feima won’t back out of his words, nor hide that weakness.
......Neither will it be transformed into Switch Form, [\s]
nor will it become Guard Form.

scene.text: With a single word- reply with one move to Wrath Form • Rockslide, only one move of Wrath Form • Rockslide!

text.p: Life and death, victory or defeat, he no longer cares, Ma Feima only lives in this moment. In his mind, that one technique Wrath Form • Rockslide.
After all,

scene.text: everything comes down to this one strike.

scene.title: 炎と氷

text.p: She unleashed her technique![\s]
The giant sword 「Redsweord」 created a tornado of sand with such force that it seemed to collapse even the mountain.
She unleashed her technique![\s]
The balustrade stretches straight out. It's 「Shunjin」!
It's not a defensive sword or kaken, but an open blade!

cg.img: 氛围_第二折_瞬尘对山崩

text.p: Open sword versus open blade—[\s]
Her qi shot out of her sword, and she headed straight for the opponent without hesitation!
She had risked her life to launch a desperate attack. Sushang seemed prepared for the clash—[\s]
But in reality, that wasn't the case.

scene.text: The idea of slamming an open sword into the opening was something I’d come up with when 「Shinkaze」 injured me.
In the mysterious spiral of yellow and blue, Li Sushang made eye contact with a Raksha for just an instant

text.p: Her green eyes were vacant, but she was looking in her direction.
In that moment... Li Sushang completely believed in him.

scene.text: [em italic]I'm sure the Raksha will lend us a hand![/em]

text.p: And if the Raksha lends a hand—
I'll never lose!

motion.img: 奥托-严肃-单空手-远景（棺材）

text.p: It was a rough outline I’d made based on such thoughts, but the time had come to decide who would win or lose.
The Raksha raised his left hand behind the two of them, who were throwing all their strength into a sword.

cg.img: 氛围_通用_犹大誓约启动

text.p: The golden cross appeared in his hand out of nowhere and vanished as if on fire—[\s]
It was 「Oath of Judah」, one of the three greatest Divine Key Treasures in Shicksal!!!
The catalyst that was the legacy of an ancient god reappeared!
An invisible chain flew toward the Ma Feima's form, binding him!
Target... fixed!
Seriously... Prohibition!
The scene of Li Sushang and "Eagle"'s fight to the death, which happened about three nights ago.[\s]
Suddenly, Ma Feima's heart palpitated. His true spirit had vanished from his body...

dialog.p: [em italic]（What—?[/em][\s]
[em italic]What happened----?）[/em]

scene.text: In the span of a moment, Ma Feima’s thoughts raced through his mind and he found out what had caused it.
scene.dialog: [em italic]（The Raksha Demon!!!）[/em]
scene.text: The anticipation and joy that had been suppressed suddenly exploded.
scene.dialog: [em italic]（You've finally laid a hand on me!?）[/em]
「Very well!!」
scene.text: Ma Feima shouted in a loud voice.
scene.dialog: 「That's what I have to do. Come at me!」

text.p: He loosened his grip and let go of the sword![\s]
—But the force of that mountain collapse had reached its peak, and there was no stopping it now.
It doesn't matter if I have my true feelings sealed away![\s]
The greatsword 「Redsweord」 flies forward with all its might!

scene.text: At the same time, Ma Feima brought his left hand forward. It was also an open sword: a mountain cave-in―

text.p: Even if he loses his Uchiko, this is still the sixth disciple of Taikyou Kenpai: Lord Mahiko—a veteran!

scene.text: He slammed a heavy blow from his well-developed muscles into the blade of an eavesdrop, pushing it upwards.

text.p: Shah----[\s]
And then...[\s]
Boom—
The kenjo grazed the top of Ma Feima’s head, slicing a few striations through his hair.[\s]
The crimson shadow flew right next to Sushang. Her young body was sucked in by a large force and dragged backward, falling onto the ground

scene.text: Her left shoulder was close to the crimson shadow. Because of that, she had been caught up in a sand flow and suffered deep enough wounds for her bones could be seen[\s]A new pain and an old one assaulted the girl all at once, knocking her unconscious.

text.p: Ma Feima won. The only technique he used was definitely 「Yamakuzure」
However, Ma Feima was also defeated because he hadn’t used 「Yamakuzure」 just once.
Li Sushang’s 「Shunjin」 was the fastest and most accurate way to open a sword
If she hadn't used 「Shunjin」, Sushang would never have posed a threat to Ma Feima in front of that mountain collapse.

scene.text: However, 「Shunjin」 wasn’t「Shinkaze」. That was why Ma Feima had been able to deflect the tip with pure muscle strength

text.p: Was that due to luck? No, it wasn't.[\s]
His ability to see techniques and analyze them was superior.[\s]
In short, there was a huge gap in ability.
This time too, it was a duel between life and death.[\s]
Ma Feima slowly turned around.[\s]
My opponent is worth putting all his strength into it.

scene.text: The Raksha stood nearby, motionless. His smile had vanished from his face; the calmness he’d been feeling earlier was gone
scene.dialog: 「You made a move.」
「You—you laid a hand on me!」

text.p: [em italic]Ah, thank goodness! This man was not a bloodless doll.
It looked like cold ice, but there were burning flames![/em]

scene.text: At this time, the joy of Ma Feima reached its peak.
Gah!

text.p: A fist completely devoid of internal power struck the Raksha’s cheek.
Even though the Raksha had guessed his intentions, he didn’t try to dodge or block them
The Raksha's body fell into the desert.
He staggered to his feet.

scene.dialog: 「...What kind of technique was that? Containing my true strength.」
scene.text: A large man walked toward the blond one.
scene.dialog: 「Apparently there’s a mysterious technique called 『Gentenkaki』 in the southwest Frontier, but your skill is clearly different. You were so far away from me that how did you seal it? ...Could this be poisoned or something? No—when was she poisoning my body again」
「Oh, well. I don’t care about that at all

dialog.p: What's important is that you declared war through your actions.」

scene.text: Ma Feima stopped in front of the Raksha and appraised him, making no attempt to hide it.
Blood oozed from the sand-scratched wound, and his handsome face looked very dirty. But he slowly stood up to straighten himself out before staring at Ma Feima with strange green eyes

motion.img: 奥托-伤严肃-单空手-远景

scene.dialog: 「...Aren't you going to go get that sword?」
scene.text: The Raksha asked.
scene.dialog: 「Huh? Don't worry about it. If you need something, then we can go and get them in time for the trip!」
「Besides, if you can seal away the seriousness of it all—relying too much on 『Redsweord』 will put us at a disadvantage.」
scene.text: Ma Feima looked behind him as if following the gaze of a Raksha, and he couldn’t help but laugh
scene.dialog: 「I know what you are worried about. Don't worry, that girl is fine」
「There's no need to worry about that girl or think of a way out right now—all you gotta do is put all your true strength into killing me, and everything will be settled. Right? Isn’t it hard for ya?」
scene.text: The Raksha is silent. It seems he's thinking about something...
scene.dialog: 「So, are you going to take my sword?」
「Huh?」
scene.text: Surprised for a moment, Ma Feima continued laughing loudly.
scene.dialog: 「Haha. I'll take your sword? You talk big! Very funny, very interesting... Let me see what you can do with it — which kind of blade are we going to use here in the first place? Is that her hilt hanging from a tree branching off my neck or something?」
scene.text: The Raksha turned his gaze downward and sighed.
scene.dialog: 「There's no need.」

scene.title: 消えた炎

mono.p: Ma Feima’s smile froze.

scene.mono: His eyes opened slowly, and his mouth opened unconsciously.
This is the exact expression of someone completely bewildered.

mono.p: [em italic]Why?[/em]
He hasn’t experienced a shock like this for many years.
[em italic]How could it be possible?[/em]
Certain feelings that had been buried for a long time surged once again.
There was envy,
Jealousy,
Self hatred,
Ecstasy,
Regret…
…And also nostalgia.
[em italic]How… could it be possible?[/em]
All kinds of emotions, as a flaming sword materialized in the Raksha’s hand rushed into his heart, shattering his Blade Mantra of Still Water and Dustless.
Ma Feima couldn’t believe his eyes:
What was happening everywhere in his vision, was definitely not like one of [Redsweord]’s illusions.
A sword of flames.
A few moments ago, there was definitely nothing in the Raksha’s hands, definitely!
If so… where did this flaming sword condensed by Ki come from?
[Eminence…]
Ma Feima murmured,
Such martial arts, Ma Feima only knew one such technique in his life.
Edge of Taixuan’s Fifth Essence: Eminence.
Creating a blade with one’s spirit, with Ki born from themself.
Only Master Phoenix and Fifth Senior Sister mastered such peerless sword skills.
At this moment, it appeared in the hands of the blond Raksha.
Absolute shock shattered Ma Feima’s Blade Mantra.
Then his boiling fighting spirit reforged another Blade Mantra.
Water no longer stilled, dust no longer settled.
It is called
Joy
Excitement
Happiness
Satisfaction
Longing
Yearning
Pleasure…
[You, are you ready?]
The Raksha asked.
The blond man held a scarlet sword in his hand, the sword blazing with flames.
The hand holding the sword was engulfed by flames, completely scorched to a black color.
[You, are you ready?]
——This man, he’s like an apostle from the underworld.
Ma Feima nodded, he had forgotten how to speak.
How long has it been? Since Master Phoenix left that sword wound on his face, just how long has it been?[\s]
He had never faced any scarier threat, and he had never been any closer to the underworld![\s]
Never again, he had faced such a desperate situation whilst on the verge of exhaustion!
Come on, come on!
Come on, Raksha demon!
I’ll use all my strength to take this blade!
The Ki surrounding Ma Feima poured into every major orifice of his body,
Not caring whether his body could bear the corruption, not caring about about the physical damage,
Just waiting for this sword to come, a sword coming!
The Raksha swung the sword, the light of his sword slashed the air, sizzling.[\s]
Guard Form, Switch Form… Edge of Taixuan’s strongest defensive moves passed one by one through Ma Feima’s mind.
Then, unsurprisingly,
Ma Feima knew that this sword of unstoppable might, this force of absolute destructive power,
All forms of defense are meaningless.
It turns out, the sword is such a terrible object,
Just like a crimson reaper.
It turns out, life is such a fragile thing,
just like a spark.
It turns out, today’s the day of death, not too late nor too soon.
However, being defeated by Eminence’s hands, what regrets would there be?
Little Ma
Su Mei’s smile flashed before Ma Feima’s eyes.
And then came the fire, the burning fire.[\s]
It burned, then burned, then burned.
The fire went out, the flame extinguished.

scene.title: 太虚の五番弟子

mono.p: The flames went out.
The light of the flames that had once risen to sky—the heat from burning even gold at one point, suddenly vanished without a trace

scene.dialog: （Huh? I wonder what's wrong—）

mono.p: It turned into pain. Pain surged from my chest and stomach, shoulder blades or the crown of his head all at once—it was as if a flood had broken through an embankment

scene.dialog: （Where am I—）

mono.p: What answered her was intense pain. All of it pounded in my head, and the sound mixed with that heartbeat so loud I couldn't sleep

scene.dialog: （Shut up! Just shut your mouth. I'll wake you—）
scene.text: Li Sushang slowly opened her eyes.
It was a familiar ceiling, the cabin I'd grown accustomed to. The person staring at me by my side had also looked very well-recognized

text.p: ...I felt safe, and I was so used to seeing her that it seemed the same as always.

scene.dialog: 「Master... Takumi?」
「Yes.」
scene.text: Lingshuang replied without wasting a single moment.
scene.dialog: 「Heheh. I...
Ouch!」
scene.text: The girl tried to sit up, but she immediately cried out in pain.
The wounds from his battle with Ma Feima weren't light. At this moment, just moving a little was enough to make him feel unbearable pain all over

mono.p: Huh?
Ma Feima?

scene.dialog: 「Ah!」
scene.text: As if waking up from a dream, Sushang spoke hastily without paying any attention to the pain.
scene.dialog: 「Master, there's trouble! Teacher and aunt are here.」

motion.img: 素裳-疲惫无神-背手-近景

scene.dialog: 「What are you in such a hurry for? You're afraid of Lord Yanqingsama.」
scene.text: Lingshuang spoke coldly.
scene.dialog: 「Who do you think sent us off? Don't worry. If I treat your wounds, we will kick that man out of the house!」
scene.text: A violent pain assaulted the girl's head, and she couldn’t think carefully about it.
scene.dialog: 「Ah—a Raksha?! Master, the blond one」
「I'll be by your side.」

motion.img: 素裳-疲惫无神-背手-近景

scene.text: Having been told that, Sushang looked to her side and saw a Raksha sleeping next door.
It was a little surprising, but this had been the first time I’d seen him close his eyes since we met.

mono.p: ...Sadness welled up in her innocent heart, like sympathy.
The blond-haired man who was fast asleep had the grace of a god, clear as day.
But right now, he seemed closer to flesh and blood than when she was awake.
She didn’t try to gloss over it or hide, nor did she worry about the past and fixate on her future.
The Raksha was simply sleeping. He slept, no different from any other normal person in the world...
Maybe... this is his true form?

scene.text: ...Huh?
Where could he be?
scene.dialog: 「Aaahh----」
scene.text: The girl instinctively pulled on the comforter and kicked a Raksha with her foot.
The blond outlander fell off the bed and toppled over, but he still didn’t wake up.
scene.dialog: 「Wh-why is this person standing next to me...?」
scene.text: Her face turns bright red. Tears are welling up in her eyes, and she looks like they're about to fall out of them at any moment... But Lingshuang is completely unfazed by it all!
scene.dialog: 「There's only one bed, right? Where am I supposed to put her if she doesn’t sleep beside you. On the floor...」
「M-Master, there's a bed at your place too!」
「――If I put this person to sleep, where will i go?」
「I-I can't do that! Not yet...」
scene.text: Unable to speak, Sushang sobbed.
scene.dialog: 「Master—it’s not good for a man and woman to make direct contact!」
scene.text: Master lowered her eyes and silently thought.
The girl sighed and suddenly realized something. It would be a little unreasonable to have her master understand this kind of common sense, wouldn't it?
After all—

scene.title: 太虚の五番弟子2

mono.p: She is the 5th disciple of the Taixuan faction, and the only person other than Phoenix in the last 100 years who has mastered the supreme boundary "Taixuanshin".
At the age of two she began to learn martial arts, and at the age of thirteen she reached the realm of Taixuan. She is a peerless swordsman who is called "the supreme divine sword that forgets me".
In the past thirty-seven years of her life, Lingshuang has never really set foot in the world, always holding a sword.
She has no setbacks, no failures, no half-hearted desires, no bonds.
Her common sense, rules, logic, reason, worldly circumstances...Lingshuang didn't pay any attention to anything that constrained ordinary people.

scene.text: But……
scene.dialog: "Yes. It was my fault."
scene.text: Luckily, only she and those close to her knew...
scene.dialog: "At your age, it's only natural to think about men."
scene.text: This person's dogmatic ability is truly amazing.
scene.dialog: “???……What did you say!?”
scene.text: Sushang was so embarrassed by her, she didn't know what to do, and she involuntarily turned her attention to the Raksha's body. She even stares at him appreciatively.
The Raksha is lying on the ground in a strange position, but no one tries to pick him up and put him to bed.
scene.dialog: "I'm a little old."
scene.text: Lingshuang said coldly.
scene.dialog: "Neither you nor your mother have an eye for men."
"Huh? You're wrong! Master, it's a misunderstanding――"

motion.img: 素裳-悲伤目下-背手-近景

scene.text: Sushang hurriedly waved her hand, trying to distract her from the topic.
scene.dialog: "Um, ka, ka, ka, is his wound okay?"
"Not good. Much heavier than you."

motion.img: 素裳-悲伤目前-普通-近景

scene.dialog: "Is this wound caused by that Ma Fei... Master?"
scene.text: Lingshuang shook her head.
scene.dialog: "With this level of power, I don't think I'll attract Lord Yanqing's attention. He ran out of strength and was defeated."
"In order to fight Lord Yanqing, he literally used up every drop of real energy in his body. I don't know what wickedness he used, but it's a good thing he didn't die."
scene.text: Master looks at the blond man lying on the floor.
scene.dialog: "My hand is burnt and probably useless. My muscles and bones weren't affected, but the internal injuries were so severe that my life span would have been reduced by 10 years, and various adverse effects might occur. Don't be like this man, think again."

motion.img: 素裳-悲伤目下-抱手-近景

scene.dialog: "... This person is fine."

mono.p: Sushang stares at Raksha's blackened arm. It was no longer visible in human hands.
But she believed he would recover. And she believed in that "Abyss Flower" that she could heal the body.
She had experienced Sushang first-hand, so she understood her wonder.
If only he was sincere enough...

motion.img: 素裳-悲伤目前-背手-近景

scene.dialog: "Master, I have a request."
"Yes, tell me."
"Um... can you share your master's sword spirit with him?"
"Taixuan? I don't think he can master it at his age. You should teach him the tricks of the sword and let him try it himself."

motion.img: 素裳-悲伤目下-抱手-近景

scene.dialog: "Eh? I didn't intend to do that.
wait. Can I teach you some kenshin tips? ”
"Why not?"
"Oh, isn't it forbidden by the ancestors to tell the outside world?"

motion.img: 素裳-悲伤目前-背手-近景

scene.text: The Fifth Disciple of the Taixuan Sword School closed his eyes and lost himself in thought, then opened his eyes again after a while.
scene.dialog: "I can't teach you. Give up."

motion.img: 素裳-绝望张嘴-抱手-近景

scene.dialog: "I also...
Oh no! What I'm trying to say is that I want his master's Taixuan to restore his inner strength.
He has an amazing dharma, and with enough sincerity, he can heal any wound. ”
"defect."
scene.text: Lingshuang nodded slightly.
scene.dialog: "Then wait a minute. I'll lend you a hand once I get rid of Lord Yanqing."
"Thank you, master!"
scene.text: Sushang smiled broadly.
scene.dialog: “After all, master is the best!”
"Yes. You guys, get some sleep."
scene.text: Sushang was surprised and hurriedly waved her hand.
scene.dialog: "No, nene--I'm not going to sleep!"

scene.title: 刃不破
scene.text: The sun has set, the last vestiges of its light setting westward.
Ma Feima looked at the sky.

mono.p: There were only clouds and the afterglow in the sky. There was nothing special about the clouds or the afterglow,
but Ma Feima watched them intently nonetheless.
It didn’t matter what he was looking at, but that he was waiting.
He didn’t like to wait, but he was very good at it.
He’d been a faithful companion to waiting for these past 10 years.

scene.text: Creak—
A quiet squeaky noise sounded behind him.
Ma Feima turned around to see a girl leaning by the door, scowling at him:
scene.dialog: [Old Sixth. You’ve aged so much.]
[Heh, I can always count on Senior Sister’s brutal honesty. It’s been twenty years, that’s bound to happen.]
scene.text: Ma Feima couldn’t help but laugh. All these years, and his Fifth Senior Sister was still just as she was then. How was that not something to be happy about?
scene.dialog: [Looks like age hasn’t matured you one bit.]
scene.text: Lingshuang glanced inside the room and said coldly:

dialog.p: [You’ve always been a pretty good kid, and now you pick up fights whenever you want.
Who gave you the right to hurt my disciple?]

text.p: Ma Feima stood there for a second. Even if he knew that his Fifth Senior Sister had taken in a disciple, he never actually associated the bonds of a master and a disciple with her.
To him, she’d always been cold and emotionless.

scene.dialog: [Who’s… That little girl?]
[She’s Seventh Sister’s daughter.]
[No wonder she looked familiar, she’s Suyi’s —
What’s her name again?]
[Sushang.]
[Oh, kind of sounds like her mom’s name.]
The woman showed no reaction to his statement.
scene.text: [Fine… Let’s cut the pleasantries.]
Ma Feima said, smiling.
He raised his hand, and a gigantic object appeared.
It was a crimson greatsword about five feet in length. It looked kind of like Sushang’s Xuanyuan.
The fifth disciple of Taixuan stared coldly at her sixth brother’s greatsword, a complicated look sparkling in her eyes.
scene.dialog: But all she said in the end was:

dialog.p: [What? Are you trying to show off?]
[Hahaha! No! I could never boast in front of my Fifth Senior Sister! I’d have no chance of winning even if you don’t have your Xuanyuan Sword.]

scene.text: Ma Feima laughed heartily, but then adopted a more serious look, bowing down to the woman:
scene.dialog: [It’s been twenty years, and I wanted to ask you for a duel to see if I’ve grown at all.]
[You truly have gotten old. You weren’t like this before.]
[...Yes, people change.]
[For the worse, it would seem.]
scene.text: Lingshuang entered the courtyard and shook her robe.
scene.dialog: [I’ll comply, you can strike me now.]
[Are you not going to use a weapon, Senior Sister?]
[No need.]
「I'll believe you.」
scene.text: Ma Feima shook his giant greatsword in the air.
scene.dialog: [But this is a Xuanyuan Sword. The wounds they’d inflict are no joke, are you sure?]
[Shut up, you think I don’t know that? It’s not like I have a [Xuanyuan] anyway, so does it matter what I use?]

text.p: Ma Feima titled his head. This wasn’t the answer he was expecting.
The duel was one thing, but he also wanted to know where that little girl’s Xuanyuan Sword came from.

scene.dialog: [Is little Sushang’s Xuanyuan Sword not yours?]
「Isn't the original sword from Lingshuang Nee-san?」
scene.text: Lingshuang looked around and spotted an empty sheath. She picked it up.
scene.dialog: [Fine fine, whatever you say. Now I have a weapon too.]
scene.text: Ma Feima stood there slightly stunned.
scene.dialog: [You’re going to use that scrap piece of wood against my 【Redsweord】?]
[Again with the 【Redsweord】...]
scene.text: She scoffed.

dialog.p: [Don’t underestimate this piece of wood, it has a name too. It’s called 【Sternsheath】.
How’s that? Is it worthy enough to face your 【Redsweord】?]

scene.dialog: [... Hahahahaha!]
scene.text: Ma Feima couldn’t hold in his laughter. He was extremely overjoyed right now.

mono.p: There were few worthy of being his opponent in these past twenty years, so he hadn’t had a chance to unsheathe【Redsweord】before.
He’d been teetering at the edge of death many times before, but this battle, one that didn’t necessarily risk his life, was the true battle of skill that he wished for.

scene.dialog: [Let’s see if【Sternsheath】can break my strike!]

scene.title: 刃不破2
scene.text: As he finished talking,【Redsweord】began to glow vibrantly. In an instant, the entire courtyard was as if it were shrouded by fog, flickering between light and darkness.
scene.dialog: [Hmph]
scene.text: Lingshuang muttered, picking up the sheath with her pointer and middle finger.
scene.dialog: [You’re only getting one hit in, so give me all you got.]
[Here it is!]

mono.p: With a roar, a second Ma Feima appeared.
This was the Taixuan Sixth Disciple’s Blade Sanction: 【Redsweord】]!
By filling the Xuanyuan Sword with Ki, and using Taixuan Blade Sanction to bend light.
The current Ma Feima had studied and practiced for decades, could now create mirror images at will.

scene.text: And so, two became four, four became eight; eight became hundreds, and hundreds became millions, innumerable as they were.

mono.p: In this abandoned courtyard of high noon, there were an infinite number of [Tireless Courser] Ma Feimas…
The same Ma Feima, the same Redsweord.
It was as if a mirror shattered in this courtyard, all of their shards reflecting the figure of the Sixth Disciple of Taixuan.

scene.text: The man held his invisible greatsword, unable to contain his excitement.
scene.dialog: [This is just a friendly sparring session,]
scene.text: She said with annoyance,
scene.dialog: [Why am I playing a guessing game with you?]
[Well it’s up to you to guess where I am then.]
scene.text: Ma Feima’s voice came from far away.
scene.dialog: [You’re too young. Some riddles are pointless, so why should I guess?]
scene.text: As she spoke, she raised her sheath towards the sky.
scene.dialog: [Hah!]

text.p: With a clear ring, the sheath【Sternsheath】shot forward,
lighting the air along its path in the courtyard in a thunderous boom.

scene.text: The fog that surrounded the two dissipated instantly and the air was shattered like a mirror.
All of the Ma Feima’s disappeared into thin air.
Under the shimmering mirror shards, Lingshuang stood stoically.
scene.dialog: [Truth among lies, not bad, you’re truly Master’s good junior disciple.]
[...So strong, heh… Junior Brother admits defeat.]
scene.text: The tip of the 【Sternsheath】was a mere inch away from his throat.
The 【Redsweord】that he raised up high was now dangling toward the ground. Ma Feima looked at it and laughed bitterly.
scene.dialog: [I knew I was no match for you, but how’d you do it? I haven’t even…]
[There were three weak points in your strike.]
scene.text: Lingshuang said, clearly disinterested:
scene.dialog: [First is that water mirror. All of your copies mirror the original’s movements, so it wasn’t hard to pinpoint your location.]
[Second is sound. You shouldn’t have answered me during battle. The Xuanyuan Sword can control light, but it can’t change the source of your sound.]
[Third was the Ki Flow. I don’t even need to look at you to tell how the Ki is flowing around where you are.]
[Ha, that’s what Second Senior Sister says too.]
[Obviously. If I could see three weak points, she’d probably be able to see more than ten.]
[Ha, fuck, looks like I wasn’t good enough after all.]
[I was gonna lose to you anyway, but to think that a sheath destroyed my Blade Sanction…]
[Don’t go too hard on yourself. You could only do parlor tricks before, but now you can make copies of yourself using Blade Sanction. That’s tremendous growth from practice already.
I’ll bet that anyone besides me, or Second, will have a hard time defeating you.]
[But since you came all this way to spar, I’ll indulge you. If I won with a trick, that’d be no fun. I want to break your strike with brute force—
Since you decided to hurt my disciple. Don’t you know the saying “You have to watch its master before you hit the dog”?]
[Also,]
scene.text: She flourished 【Sternsheath】in the air.

dialog.p: [This is just a regular old wooden sheath. I probably couldn’t use it again after this anyway.
You were not defeated by [Ascension], but by [Eminence], understand? Feel a bit better about your loss now?]

scene.title: 刃不破3
scene.text: Lingshuang sounded like she was mocking him, but Ma Feima knew this was her way of praising him.

mono.p: Purely by skill, only their Master Phoenix could rival Lingshuang now.
The powerful [Edge of Taixuan] had five essences: Mantra, Form, Sanction, Ascension, and Eminence].
To master Ascension was to master the way of the blade. One did not have to be concerned with the form of the weapon, and any weapon could become a sword.
Besides Lin Zhaoyu, who was busy studying sword arts itself, the rest of the disciples had all mastered Ascension.
But Eminence— Other than Celestial Phoenix, for thousands of years, Lingshuang alone was the only one to master this essence.
And Eminence is—
Where inaction is greater than action,
Being swordless did not mean you had no sword.

scene.dialog: Ki from the will, a sword from the mind, this is the All-Mighty Wandering Eminence.
[It’s a shame. I had a couple more moves with Redsweord I wanted to use.]
[I’ll pass. It’s a hassle dealing with even one strike with you. If it wasn’t for how stubborn and unavoidable I heard you were when it came to fighting, I wouldn’t even have lifted a finger.]
[I didn’t think you paid attention to my business.]

[There’s not much happening around these parts except your feats: Who you beat up, who you defeated, who you killed… Seriously, why’s the world suddenly revolving around you? Are all of our Senior Sisters dead or something?]
scene.text: The Sixth Disciple of Taixuan gave a forced grin. Even after twenty years he’d still find himself struggling to have a conversation with Lingshuang:
scene.dialog: [Everyone’s well. Zhaoyu is my wife right now.]

[Oh right, I heard about that. School of Taixuan, was it? No wonder she’s the eldest, she won’t even change the name. But you, I heard that right after you got married, you went off to the Northern Wastes to chase a horse for a hundred miles.]
scene.text: Ma Feima rubbed his nose and looked at Erebus. He didn’t go to the Northern Wastes for it, but he ended up meeting his lifelong best friend over there.
scene.dialog: [Did it taste good?]
scene.text: The corners of Ma Feima’s mouth twitched slightly.
scene.dialog: [....Senior Sister, stop joking with me.]
scene.text: Lingshuang wasn’t joking though:
scene.dialog: [What happened to you? You were always the good one out of all of us, never getting into any fights. Honestly, you were more like a woman than any of us, but now?
You’ve probably gotten into more fights in these past decades than our Master did over thousands of years.]
[But did you get anything out of it? Are you the Strongest of Shenzhou? Or the Supreme Leader of the Lands?]
[Haha, that’s not my intention. There’s no way I’d beat my Senior sisters no matter how much I train my Edge of Taixuan.

dialog.p: Supreme Leader… What’s that good for? Who cares about number one?
Master was so powerful, and look what happened to her…]

scene.dialog: [Well, it’s good that you know that.]
scene.text: Lingshuang let out a huff before walking towards the cottage.
scene.dialog: [My abode is a bit too small for guests. Anything else? If not, I’m going.]
[Yes.]
scene.text: Ma Feima stepped forward.
scene.dialog: [Second Sister wanted me to tell you something important, something I have to tell you personally.]
[You couldn’t have told me earlier?]
[It has something to do with Master.]
scene.text: The Fifth Disciple of Taixuan stopped in her tracks.
scene.dialog: [Oh?]

scene.title: 生きて
scene.text: Li Sushang took a lot of effort to put the unconscious Raksha into the bed.
Her head was still groggy, and her whole body was in pain when she moved her fingers. This is so, she still relied on perseverance to just accomplish this great cause.
After covering the Raksha with the quilt, she sat aside and sang a song that was out of tune.
scene.dialog: [Yiyaziyamejiegeya... Haliya…]
scene.text: This tune suddenly appeared in her mind, like a dead leaf drifting to the shore.
scene.dialog: [Eryaziyame...Haliyajieyajieya…]
scene.text: Ah, when did she hear this song and who sang it?
Inexplicably, Sushang remembered the appearance of her mother, Qin Suyi.
Suyi, in white garments, squatted in front of her to reach out and stroke her hair gently.
scene.dialog: [At such a young age, it's really hard for you to go to learn martial arts outside the Great Wall for your mother. But Mommy will arrange everything. In the future, when you are successful in mastering swordsmanship, no one in this world will dare to bully us.]
[Mommy has a lot of hardships, and if I told you now, you wouldn't understand. In this world, many things are beyond your control. But…]
“You have to live, Sushang, you have to live… promise me."
scene.text: The girl's crisp singing came to an abrupt end.
For no reason, Li Sushang activated Blade Mantra, freezing the Mind Lake into a huge piece of ice.
Thoughts sank below the water, like thousands of turbulent undercurrents.
The Mind Lake above was as clear as a mirror, illuminating everything.
Sushang suddenly felt as if she could predict the future. She knew that the door of the house was about to open, and the master walked towards her with the same indifference as before—
Everything's going according to plan.

text.p: Lingshuang dragged her dull steps and walked slowly to Sushang's side.
There was no expression on her face, as if she was not interested in anything.

scene.text: Li Sushang looked at the master and smiled instinctively, as if driving away a lingering haze.
Lingshuang paused, blinking her eyes seemingly bored, and said:
scene.dialog: [Your mother is dead.]

scene.title: 終わり
scene.text: The stone steps aren't long, but they are winding. 「Celestial Phoenix」 silently descends the stairs
Right behind me is a cute little girl. She's nimbly following after Phoenix, sometimes close to her and other times far away

The girl didn't say anything, either. Her silence was different from that of the Phoenix guardsmen—the girls were nonexistent people; every move she made had absolutely nothing to do with this world and her voice as well
Aside from Phoenix, her existence meant nothing to anyone.
And in this silent mountain, only Phoenix was able to hear the girl’s quiet whisper.
scene.dialog: 「Master, look—the mountain villa is on fire.」
scene.text: When Phoenix turned around, a line of long and thin black smoke rose up from deep in the mountains like flowers blooming with ink.
scene.dialog: [em italic]（Suyi...）[/em]
scene.text: She puts strength into her feet. In an instant, she's moved over ten meters in length...
scene.dialog: 「...It's too late, Master.」

text.p: The girl speaks in a quiet voice.
She appears before me and blocks Phoenix's path. Ink flowers are quietly circling in the sky above her

scene.text: Phoenix stopped in her tracks, only staring vacantly.

motion.img: 赤鸢-闭目（悲伤）-垂手-中景

scene.dialog: 「...Qin Suyi is dead, and the Sword Mountain Manor is destined to be with its master.」
scene.text: The girl murmured.
scene.dialog: 「Master, there's no point in going back. When you show up it will bring ruin to the world and we cannot remove that from our minds!」
「They shouldn't have died.」
「So who should have died? You've changed, Master. The previous master would never care about whether a human lives or dies in the first place!」
「...You didn't mind?」

dialog.p: 「All my master cared about was how to live—in other words, 『Stampede of qi』.
Hehe. If a human falls into that trap, they might as well be dead!」

scene.text: The girl shrugged her shoulders, glanced at the black smoke far away and asked further.
scene.dialog: 「Where is 『Sumizomeka』?」
「No matter how hard I tried, Suyi wouldn't tell me where Sumizome Incense was. Ahh... She died and many things were lost forever—」
「But Master won't give up, will he? No matter how much time it takes to find all the 『Hekihan』 『Disciple』s and get them back.」
scene.text: Phoenix looked up at the sky and unconsciously nodded.
scene.dialog: 「Haha, I believe you can do it.」
scene.text: Phoenix was shocked by those words, and instinctively turned her gaze to the girl’s face.
The girl is looking straight at Phoenix.

mono.p: Her gaze was very sincere, and her smile brimmed with shame.
Her words were filled with passion, full of respect and trust.
She's...
I feel like he knows her well.
I spent time with them long ago...
I've spent a very long time with them.

scene.text: Phoenix raises her brow, blinking. She was trying to get a clear look at the beautiful girl in front of them
She looked to be about seventeen or eighteen years old. That wasn’t strange—time was frozen in her world, after all
The girl wasn't real, just one of the countless phantoms created by Phoenix’s wounded brain. But she was all that remained—the illusion appeared and disappeared; it faded away when brightly lit up
—The woman who once killed him with her own hands.
Would there be anyone who understood her more than the person responsible for killing him?
scene.dialog: 「Please tell me... What kind of person am I?」
scene.text: The seemingly nonexistent girl smiles gently.
scene.dialog: 「I'm sure you are well aware of this. It is merely a memory, and the answer to any question that may arise from it cannot be solved at all!」
「Perhaps it's simply the result of my master asking herself a question, or perhaps an introspection that is difficult to accept. Or maybe our casual conversation and letters...」
「My answer is etched deeply into my master's memory, but it will be very difficult to determine whether or not that was true.」
「Master, all of your current pain is nothing more than an obsession with the past—but that history no longer exists.」

motion.img: 赤鸢-闭目（悲伤）-垂手-中景

scene.dialog: 「Oblivion is a gift that removes all the burden of your past. And this world has such vastness to it, so you can go anywhere and do what needs doing—you're free as master!」
scene.text: Phoenix said nothing. However, she knew this voice was coming from within her heart—her emotions hadn’t been murdered for an endless number of years; they were just buried alive and returned after the girl died
scene.dialog: 「――Please tell me.」

「You really want to know? Once you find out... once your decision is made, it will become Phoenix again. He'll be a person of the past and walk down his old path until he ends up with that same ending as before!」

motion.img: 赤鸢-闭目（标准）-垂手-中景

scene.text: The silence felt very long, but when Phoenix opened her mouth to speak it also seemed extremely short. It was as if she had never existed or hesitated at all
scene.dialog: 「I want to know.」
「...Yes, I understand.」
scene.text: The girl closed her eyes.
scene.dialog: 「You're Phoenix, and you are our seven masters. My mother died in your hands when I was six years old... She lost control of herself as a result—and ever since that day she has been following me around with her head held high!」

「You had a strong, firm conviction. Immortality and unparalleled martial arts skills — there's no one in this world who can match you—and the first time we met was when I thought that nobody would be less impressed with your abilities than yourself」
「You look like a god, but I think that's something humans can never reach.」
「When we returned to the mountains with you, everyone rejoiced. The seven of us were all orphans and loved each other from our hearts—but as time went on for so long together...」
「That to you, we are temporary opponents and nothing more than pawns that can be thrown away once they're used.」
「You're the kind of person who, even if you are attracted to him at first... as time goes on and we spend together more often than not.」
scene.text: Phoenix remained silent. A sadness like a summer rain poured down on her heart, unfettered by anything
Finally, she voiced the question that had been weighing on her mind for over ten years.
scene.dialog: 「Zhaoyu, why did you try to kill me?」
scene.text: The girl named Lin Zhaoyu opened her eyes wide and sighed.
scene.dialog: 「Master, I've been following you for thirty years. Thirty...」
